body:
Soros Update

[INSIDE JW]

Butler Police, District Attorney Release Shooter Photos, Police Trump
Rally Security Preparations

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69663&L=33241&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvdmlkZW9zL2p1ZGljaWFsLXdhdGNoLXdlZWtseS11cGRhdGUtdy10b20tZml0dG9uLTgtMTYtMjAyNC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=60e6d19a26b480d4d711cf5e26f5276267ab96936c345906407f54420ecc3154]
We received four pages of documents
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69663&L=33234&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2J1dGxlci1jb3VudHktZGEtcHJvZHVjdGlvbi8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=a56ab41ad14ea91de6fbdd8834443b16e0007ce4edd3a181b6a7f625c3365688]
from the district attorney’s office in Butler County, Pennsylvania,
detailing the extensive preparation of local police for the rally at
which former President Trump was shot.

Local Pennsylvania law enforcement has been more transparent about the
Trump assassination attempt than the Biden-Harris administration,
which is in full cover-up mode.

The preparation by local officials included sniper teams,
counter-assault teams, and a quick response force.

On August 9, in response to a separate open records request, we also
obtained
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69663&L=33235&F=T&&hash=0eb8c23d782e571d776cf1b6d18d1eb656be4e5c892ff6bc773ad8987d162467]
bodycam footage of the July 13 assassination events from the Butler
Township Police Department.

We received today’s records in response to July 26, 2024,
Pennsylvania Right To Know Request for:

All records and documents related to President Donald Trump’s
presidential campaign rally that was held in Butler, PA, on July 13,
2024, including but not limited to:

1) site security plans, risk or threat assessments, designation of
security perimeters, plans for responding to suspicious activity or an
active threat or attack, memoranda of understanding, or other
documents establishing roles and responsibilities of federal agencies
and state, local, tribal, and territorial (SLTT) law enforcement
partner agencies, and associated chains of command.

2) All audio/video/photographic recordings captured on body-worn
cameras or other electronic devices in your possession.
Please provide records from July 1, 2024, to present.
Included with the documents were two photographs
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69663&L=33236&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL21hdHRoZXctY3Jvb2tzLXBob3Rvcy8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=9145828aacd55ec3819e86f4fcf6b2e1c73252bc9a9be8e18120bf1827cbdde5]
of
Matthew Crooks, the shooter, who was killed by law enforcement
snipers.

On July 9th, at 10:17 p.m., Sgt. Edward Lenz, Adams Township Police
Department, Mars, PA, emails
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69663&L=33237&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2J1dGxlci1jb3VudHktZGEtcHJvZHVjdGlvbi1wZy0xLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=db6469d715a76821304b19686b13825632b7aa29d5a2bfe006da621254da3771]
Richard Goldinger, with a “cc” To William Mayhugh, with the
subject: “Butler ESU Deployment” Request/ Presidential Rally 7
/13/24”. The email states:

Good evening Rich!

I just want to ensure you have the information and details regarding
the request for Butler ESU to assist this Saturday at the presidential
candidate rally:

Butler Twp PD and the US Secret Service have requested our assistance
at the rally. I have had several discussions with the USSS, and as of
today they are requesting assistance from us with providing sniper/
overwatch support, counterassault teams, and a quick reaction force.
Our current plan is to provide 2 sniper elements, 2 mobile
counterassault teams, and a quick reaction force.

* The sniper elements would provide overwatch for the rally and
would work in conjunction with the secret service counter-sniper unit
* The counterassault teams would be dedicated teams that would
respond to and address an attack directed at the presidential
candidate inside of the venue, whether it be a coordinated attack with
multiple assailants, or a single attacker.
* The quick response force would be dedicated to respond to and
address any high-risk incidents occurring outside of the venue. They
would not respond to civil disturbances – this would be handled by
uniformed members of PSP. The QRF would assist PSP at the request of
incident commander, and upon the approval of the ESU commander.

This will be manpower intensive, and Beaver County ESU and Washington
County SWAT have agreed to supplement with manpower – Beaver ESU is
going to send their armor with 6-8 operators, and Washington County
SWAT is going to send a sniper element along with 3-4 operators. The
request for assistance will be officially made through Region 13.Our
current plan is to rally at 0900 for a briefing, and to be operational
by 1100. As long as the timeline doesn’t shift, we should be
releasing the assisting agencies by 1830, but I expect Butler ESU to
remain operational until a majority of the farm snow grounds has been
cleared.

We have a law enforcement walkthrough at the farm show Thursday at
1000 , and Bill is coming to that as well I believe.

As always, if you have any questions let me know, and I will follow up
with more information should anything in our plan change!

Stay safe!

Ed
On July 9th, 2014, at 1:18 p.m., Lenz sends an email
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69663&L=33238&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2J1dGxlci1jb3VudHktZGEtcHJvZHVjdGlvbi1wZy0zLTQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=940f7a628abc33d7eddf12fa54c326862bf5269abbe6c705d5681e219fd76f52]
to Steven Bicehouse, with a “cc” to Kevin Mikulan, with the
subject: “Region 13 Tactical Support Request”. The email
states:

Good evening Sir!

Butler ESU has been requested to assist Butler Township Police and the
US Secret Service at the presidential rally this Saturday, July 13
2024. Throughout my discussions with the USSS, they have requested we
provide sniper teams and counterassault teams, as well as an
additional element available outside of the venue. This will be
manpower intensive, and I spoke with Pat Young from Beaver County ESU
and Guy Kuzak from Washington County SWAT to ask for some assistance.
Both offered to send a squad of guys with equipment to assist but
asked that an official request be submitted for Region 13 assets.

I have never submitted a request for a pre-scheduled detail, and I’m
not exactly sure what information you would need:

Date: 7/13/2024
Tactical Team Deployment Type: Dignitary Protection w/ counterassault
and sniper deployments Event Details: Presidential Candidate Rally
Event Location : Butler Farm Show Grounds
Staging Location: 121 Sparks Ave, Butler PA 16001, Butler Township FD
Arrival Time: 0900
Expected End Time: 1830 (Region assets will be released as soon as it
is operationally feasible, Butler ESU assets will expect to remain
later)

Beaver County: Butler County ESU is requesting assistance from Beaver
County ESU, specifically their armor asset, manpower, and tactical
equipment as determined by operational needs.

Washington County: Butler County ESU is requesting assistance from
Washington County SWAT, specifically with manpower and tactical
equipment as determined by operational needs.

If you do need further information just let me know, and I will get
whatever you need! Thank you!
We have more than 25 FOIA and open records currently pending on the
shooting of Trump with the Biden administration and local and state
officials and agencies in Pennsylvania.

Expect several FOIA lawsuits soon (see below!)

FBI REFUSES TO RELEASE TRUMP ASSASSINATION RECORDS

The FBI withheld information
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69663&L=33209&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZmJpLXRydW1wLWFzc2Fzc2luYXRpb24tYXR0ZW1wdC1yZWNvcmRzLWRlbmlhbC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=ff87257996dbe3058a4735462fd72cad90619c670bf8a140e81052ce6803aaf4]
in our FOIA request about its coordination with the Secret Service
regarding the July 13 Butler, Pennsylvania, rally at which former
President Trump was shot.

In denying our FOIA request, the FBI cites FOIA exemption 7(A)
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69663&L=33210&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZGhzLmdvdi9mb2lhLWV4ZW1wdGlvbnM/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=8e684b0efa123828adb2476ed0070fd603eeec199359a5c4098fdbe94bc632d5],
which applies to information
that “could reasonably be expected to interfere with enforcement
proceedings”

Our request on July 26 asked for:

All records of the FBI, including emails, email chains, email
attachments, text messages, video or audio recordings, photographs,
drawings, outlook calendars, meeting minutes, finished intelligence
products, bulletins, raw intelligence, threat products,
correspondence, statements, letters, memoranda, reports, briefings,
presentations, notes, summaries, or other form of record, regarding
preparation and coordination with the USSS for former President Donald
Trump’s presidential campaign rally that was held in Butler, PA, on
July 13, 2024. Please provide records from June 15, 2024, to
present.
We are pursuing the next steps in preparation for litigation.

Were there others involved in the assassination attempt on Trump? If
not, then why would the FBI use the excuse of protecting someone’s
right to a fair trial to hide records on the FBI’s and Secret
Service’s inexcusable failures to protect Trump from being nearly
assassinated. The Biden-Harris administration is running a major
league cover-up on the near assassination of former President Trump.

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69663&L=33146&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvYXNzYXNzaW5hdGlvbi1hdHRlbXB0LXRydW1wLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=df0f691741c7c14424d00c7ac64405fccff369da6825258cd61d1a62a1674738]

# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1789%2E135344%2ElV6oF7)

[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240816-3-900&t=2&akid=1789%2E135344%2ElV6oF7)
---
Hi friend, it’s Gary Peters.
I’m a fifth generation Michigander, former U.S. Navy Reservist, U.S Senator, and fighter for Michigan families — and I’m asking you to join me in supporting Elissa Slotkin for U.S. Senate.
As a Senator representing Michigan, and the chair of the DSCC – the body tasked with keeping our razor-thin Democratic Senate majority – I think I’m pretty qualified to say why she should join me in the Senate next year.
Elissa is Pure Michigan. It’s where both her family and mine found our versions of the American dream, and her love for this place and its people drives everything she does.
Elissa and I also share a commitment to service. After 9/11, Elissa was recruited by the CIA and served 3 tours in Iraq alongside the military. A national security expert, she went on to work in the White House and the Pentagon. 9/11 was also a call to service for me — following the attacks, I volunteered again for drilling status and served overseas as part of my Navy Reserve duty.
And most importantly, I know that Elissa will be a fighter for Michigan’s working families in the Senate. I learned it from my mom, a nurse’s aide who organized her workplace with the SEIU and became a union steward. Elissa’s “why” also comes from her mom. As her mom was battling Stage IV ovarian cancer, Elissa went toe to toe with the insurance companies after years of price gouging because of her pre-existing condition.
Elissa will be the leader that Michiganders deserve, and I’ll be proud to serve alongside her in the Senate.
**But in an election year where control of the Senate is on the line and a presidential at the top of the ticket, she has a tough fight ahead of her. And mark my words when I tell you that if Elissa does not win here in Michigan, Republicans will almost certainly take control of the U.S. Senate.**
[**So I’m asking you today: will you chip in $3 to Elissa’s campaign and help keep both of Michigan’s Senate seats blue?**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240816-3-900&t=3&akid=1789%2E135344%2ElV6oF7)

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

# Hughes Celebrates New, Affordable Senior Housing in Overbrook
_Senator Hughes attended the groundbreaking ceremony for Good Shepherd Senior, a new 55-unit senior community project offering high-quality, one-bedroom apartments for seniors. _
* * *
Sen. Hughes joined community and church leaders this week to celebrate the groundbreaking for a new 55-unit affordable senior housing community at the site for the former Good Shepherd Presbyterian Church in Overbrook. ** "A lack of affordable housing is changing the fabric of our communities and displacing long-time residents," Hughes said. "I've made it a priority to steer critical state investments toward projects that promise to allow seniors to spend their golden years in the neighborhoods they know." ****- Senator Hughes**
* * *
_A brand new 55-unit Senior Housing Community is __Coming to the 7th District_
* * *
After a fire destroyed the church in 2016, church leaders worked with Pennrose LLC and the Wynnefield Overbrook Revitalization Corporation (WORC) to turn a bold idea into reality. Sen. Hughes secured a $1 million state RACP grant for the project, part of his on-going Housing Investment Plan that has [steered millions of dollars toward affordable housing](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100168448.172226.62&gen=1&mailing_linkid=11620)efforts in the 7th District. He recently announced more than $5.9 million in Low Income Housing Tax Credits for Good Shepherd and four other projects in his district to construct more than 200 units of housing. In Philadelphia, more than 59,000 households are on the waiting list for affordable housing - and in Overbrook alone, nearly two-thirds of renters spend a third of their income on rent. Scheduled to open late next year, the four story, 53,000-square-foot Good Shepherd project will offer high-quality, one-bedroom apartments for seniors available at 20 percent to 60 percent of the Area Median Income (AMI), about $430 to $1,290 for a one-person household. The sustainable building will be designed to meet Enterprise Green Communities and Zero Energy Ready Home standards.
* * *
**" This project will provide more than just a roof and walls," Hughes said. "Church leaders are working with the WORC to provide on-site support services tailored to the needs of the seniors and the neighborhood." ****- Senator Hughes**

# Join the Movement – Get Your United College Park T-Shirt Tomorrow!

Dear United College Park Community, We’re thrilled to have you as part of our movement to bring positive change to the city we love. Your passion for voter education, community empowerment, and creating a better future for College Park has brought us together, and we couldn’t be more excited to have you on board. Tomorrow, we’re hosting our very first pop-up sale for the United College Park t-shirts that have become a symbol of our collective effort. These shirts have been making waves in the neighborhood, and now it’s your chance to wear one with pride! **Pop-Up Sale** **Date:** Saturday, August 16th **Time:** 10:30 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. **Location:** 2071 Rugby Avenue, College Park, Georgia **Price:** Starting at $20 per t-shirt
**Note:** Colors and sizes are limited, so be sure to arrive early to grab your preferred style. This event is more than just a sale – it’s an opportunity to connect with your neighbors, share your passion for our community, and learn more about the exciting changes we’re working towards. Your involvement is what makes this movement strong, and we can’t wait to see you there. Thank you for being a vital part of United College Park. Together, we’re shaping the future of our city. See you tomorrow! Warm regards, The United College Park Team

body:
I want to tell you what being a veteran means to me. From the yellow footprints at recruit training to the desert of Iraq, I hope this message finds you well.

| | | | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zoi6n0r5d4111m18rbvvkcouhlgvun4dhf4r9aog_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ge1o76c3h2bs)
---
|
---
Friend,
I want to take a moment to tell you about my path to becoming a United States Marine, and what being a veteran means to me.
I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio.
Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our “leaders” in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind.
**_Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream._**
When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn’t know what I was getting into.
But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life.

[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zj4k1th8rpnjvuth29a1cfcd9lam43162i1scf3g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ge1o76c3h2bs)
Compared to others I served with, I think my time in the Corps was rather unremarkable.
I deployed to Iraq, did my duty, and I’m proud of my service. But I was lucky. There were some scary moments, but it wasn’t like you’d see in the movies.
My time in the Corps was nothing compared to the sacrifices made by generations of Marines that came before me - and a lot in my own generation.
We ask so much of our men and women deployed around the globe. And they do it with honor and humility.
**_That’s what keeps me going every single day. Our veterans and servicemen, young and old, need to know we have their backs._**
President Trump was the best Commander-in-Chief of my lifetime, and if we’re going to get him back in the White House, it will all come down to your support.
**_[Kamala Harris is raising millions, so today, I’m humbly asking you to chip in just $5 to get President Trump back in the White House.>](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z3dedjh0bffius9ikp06klteta8n6j4aakvcummo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ge1o76c3h2bs)_**

[DONATE TODAY](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z8lll9s0vlqc81s0mctv5kfba20hs6h04ekps50g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ge1o76c3h2bs)
My time as a Marine taught me that every man has to do his part.
I won’t run from the biggest fights we face as a nation.
If you give me this opportunity, you have my word that President Trump & I will fight tooth and nail to put you and your family FIRST.
**_[Please show your support today. I promise that President Trump& I will never stop fighting for YOU.>](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zpdpo523fhik7m9qgnpo0cvub9nq60edm7u35o50_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ge1o76c3h2bs)_**

[DONATE TODAY](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zt1j4bal5tqrcpqc7j3umfgppdr503loqt5av3dg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ge1o76c3h2bs)
Thank you and may God bless you,
[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2ztbsjer9l9fpuvb354i6o7fd1h6rhg7iaquqjus8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ge1o76c3h2bs)

| | | Hello, As a fellow conservative, you likely already well know and feel the pressure that is being put upon you to abandon your principles by the progressives on the far left. You know that fighting back for what you believe in is the best thing to do. In these trying times, we conservatives must turn to the greatest document in the history of the world to promise freedom and opportunity to its citizens for guidance; **our Constitution.** That’s why I’m writing today. I’d like to offer you the chance to gain **[free access to Heritage’s Guide to the Constitution today to help you defend your principles against those on the far left.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z20ima5784n01bhoqg04t6jdj99efjg8vp125uso_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ge1o76cjh2bs)** [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zmjm5sj9d3ggtfho4gah5klqtam19rbsabne0reo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ge1o76cjh2bs) In this free digital interactive guide, you'll find:
* **Useful, clause-by-clause analysis** of the entire Constitution and each amendment
* Input from more than **100 constitutional scholars and legal experts** including President Reagan's former Attorney Ed Meese
* **A thorough review** of what the Constitution actually says and how it applies today
* **A copy of the Constitution** and the documents that served as its foundation

This is a critical year in our nation’s history. The country is polarized and divided on a great number of issues, and roughly half of the voting population is being swayed towards greater government control over our lives—they want government-controlled health care, higher taxes and redistribution of wealth in the form of socialism, increased regulations, to do away with the Electoral College, and for open borders. It is for this reason that we need to educate as many people as possible, of all age groups, the freedoms promised to us in the Constitution. Because if we don’t truly understand the freedoms that it promises to us as citizens, then we will not fight to defend those freedoms. name: Jen Kiggans
subject: Pictures from the scrapbook.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kiggans for Congress
body:
My name is Jen Kiggans, and I want to tell you a little bit about myself

| |
---
| | |
My name is Jen Kiggans, and I want to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm the Democrats #1 target.

In 2022, I defeated a liberal Democrat in one of the closest elections in the entire country to help Republicans retake the House of Representatives. They are already spending big bucks to try and defeat me, so I wanted to see if you would be willing to support our campaign.

But first, I wanted to tell you a little about myself and what led me to run for Congress in the first place.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2ze6mtersuoicq8ijmsiu55h4phhl0831oosia5eg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ge1o76chh2bs)
---

That photo above is me and my husband, Steve. He is a retired F-18 pilot, and I'm a proud Navy wife and mother to four amazing children.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2za8ll23imukii2njb72u8hj2pqj4ubm7v885vesg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ge1o76chh2bs)
---

I also served in the Navy. That photo above is my helicopter with my call sign on it - "Blossom." I was winged as a naval aviator in 1995 and served our nation for a total of 10 years as a helicopter pilot flying H-46 and H-3 helicopters, completing two deployments to the Persian Gulf.

After serving in the Navy, I used my GI Bill benefits to go back to school and become a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. It was an honor to care for our Greatest Generation, and I helped them fight the system to get the healthcare they deserve.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zt4lncf9qtuuul5et5h03446vmc4ss4qug5rvo08_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ge1o76chh2bs)
---

Over time, I got frustrated watching the evening news and just hearing about all the dysfunction and radical agendas in our government. But I'm not one to just complain about problems. I like to solve them.

_**So I got off my couch, and I ran for office.**_

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zoqe5un1afg1006s21e167enum79fl08jkser0cg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ge1o76chh2bs)
---

I served three sessions in the Virginia State Senate, where I used my real-world experience to actually solve problems. I was proud to champion legislation to promote election security, establish a Military Spouse Liaison, and advocate for patients, families, and caregivers in long-term care facilities.

Eventually, I realized a lot of the problems facing my family, our neighbors, and our community were actually coming from Washington. We were represented by a Democrat who voted with Nancy Pelosi 99% of the time, and I felt we needed a representative who would actually put our values and community first.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zu3k89tu71uep4ofime5pe71udo4n5cste66pvdo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ge1o76chh2bs)
---

So, I once again decided to stop complaining and _actually do something about it_. So I ran for Congress!

When I commit to something, I give it my all, and that's what we did with the campaign. We were up against a lot. National Democrats poured over $10 million into my opponent's campaign, and big money PACs spent even more attacking me.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z3agm1eqgr6f2vc8bm0uadhov8a5rlgg9oj2mpeo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ge1o76chh2bs)
---

But, we stayed focused on the task at hand and never lost sight of why I was running. On Election Night, we won by about 10,000 votes in one of the closest races in the entire nation.

And in Congress, we've already been able to make a big impact. **We are standing up for veterans, parents, taxpayers, and hard-working Americans.** We're making good progress, but the work is just getting started.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zelu40v088knsfl9s9u8k0jnjop4o5dvm4emiic0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ge1o76chh2bs)
---

**But the Democrats and their deep pocket donors are already setting out to defeat me.** The Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee has announced my seat is one of their top targets in 2024, so I'm hoping you will donate today to help our campaign keep going strong.

---
| | [KEEP JEN IN THE FIGHT](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zo60srv8pake52faj5kotved1a944j4d3jd7p28g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ge1o76chh2bs "DONATE TO JEN KIGGANS")
---

If you want to see more regular, everyday citizens in office instead of career politicians, then I need your urgent help. Can you spare anything to help me defeat the Democrats in this #1 Battleground race?

I can't stand sending messages like this. Sometimes I wonder what would have happened if I never got off the couch and ran for office...but then I remember that America is always worth protecting...no matter what!

Thanks for reading my message. I hope I was able to earn your support.

---
| | [DONATE NOW](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zpg2gs64buo04khicp4k9n80vvj27ecjbcep6aeo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ge1o76chh2bs "DONATE TO JEN KIGGANS")
---

-Jen

Democrats are working overtime to DEFEAT Navy Veteran Jen Kiggans!

They know if they flip Jen's seat, that they can retake the entire House Majority. _**We can 't let that happen!**_

As a Navy veteran, Nurse Practitioner, and Mom, Jen is committed to servant leadership. But without YOUR support, she risks losing the ability to fight for you and our values!

name: JD Vance
subject: United States Marine Corps
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trump National Committee JFC Inc
body:
I want to tell you what being a veteran means to me. From the yellow footprints at recruit training to the desert of Iraq, I hope this message finds you well.

| | | | [](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zqp1i0caivf1b8b9696aeba05a7f4qdqovqfge4o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ge9pr2c5h2bs)
---
|
---
Friend,
I want to take a moment to tell you about my path to becoming a United States Marine, and what being a veteran means to me.
I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio.
Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our “leaders” in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind.
**_Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream._**
When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn’t know what I was getting into.
But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life.

[](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zkc270ad8igicl1tu5qmv664go4blpns2u91o21o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ge9pr2c5h2bs)
Compared to others I served with, I think my time in the Corps was rather unremarkable.
I deployed to Iraq, did my duty, and I’m proud of my service. But I was lucky. There were some scary moments, but it wasn’t like you’d see in the movies.
My time in the Corps was nothing compared to the sacrifices made by generations of Marines that came before me - and a lot in my own generation.
We ask so much of our men and women deployed around the globe. And they do it with honor and humility.
**_That’s what keeps me going every single day. Our veterans and servicemen, young and old, need to know we have their backs._**
President Trump was the best Commander-in-Chief of my lifetime, and if we’re going to get him back in the White House, it will all come down to your support.
**_[Kamala Harris is raising millions, so today, I’m humbly asking you to chip in just $5 to get President Trump back in the White House.>](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2ze5drnd00pond26va92q3rv5779qs7o55psp2h88_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ge9pr2c5h2bs)_**

[DONATE TODAY](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z17n56jho8foej3ipio89gciij5r7fv9s7m1bgvo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ge9pr2c5h2bs)
My time as a Marine taught me that every man has to do his part.
I won’t run from the biggest fights we face as a nation.
If you give me this opportunity, you have my word that President Trump & I will fight tooth and nail to put you and your family FIRST.
**_[Please show your support today. I promise that President Trump& I will never stop fighting for YOU.>](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zd8pgaaelq7kce1kr6je40m7inisjlmiehkkmh0g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ge9pr2c5h2bs)_**

[DONATE TODAY](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zij9tacbno4kt6nijrglqlmo8thvqk371r398cv8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ge9pr2c5h2bs)
Thank you and may God bless you,
[](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zetd61b6isbm7us363lhardp30rjug9mefp52gkg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ge9pr2c5h2bs)

JD Vance Future Vice President of the United States
PS: If you can’t afford to donate because Kamala Harris has wrecked our economy, please save your donation for another time. I only ask that you please say a prayer for everyone currently serving in harm’s way.

name: Tony Johnson
subject: Defend your personal liberties laid out in the Constitution
body:
In these trying times, we conservatives must turn to the greatest document in the history of the world

| | |
---
| | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z49c3b8g4gl5b2ia1oe1dhqsmr121e5rmssj7uu0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie0or2cph2bs)
---
| | | Hello, As a fellow conservative, you likely already well know and feel the pressure that is being put upon you to abandon your principles by the progressives on the far left. You know that fighting back for what you believe in is the best thing to do. In these trying times, we conservatives must turn to the greatest document in the history of the world to promise freedom and opportunity to its citizens for guidance; **our Constitution.** That’s why I’m writing today. I’d like to offer you the chance to gain **[free access to Heritage’s Guide to the Constitution today to help you defend your principles against those on the far left.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z4gu2vq8pjl2sap2g6qlkiqktq0ibk11ldqsdino_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie0or2cph2bs)** [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvqhd28krjav2jf6acmthtpin3667hc3jhobmtbg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie0or2cph2bs) In this free digital interactive guide, you'll find:
* **Useful, clause-by-clause analysis** of the entire Constitution and each amendment
* Input from more than **100 constitutional scholars and legal experts** including President Reagan's former Attorney Ed Meese
* **A thorough review** of what the Constitution actually says and how it applies today
* **A copy of the Constitution** and the documents that served as its foundation

This is a critical year in our nation’s history. The country is polarized and divided on a great number of issues, and roughly half of the voting population is being swayed towards greater government control over our lives—they want government-controlled health care, higher taxes and redistribution of wealth in the form of socialism, increased regulations, to do away with the Electoral College, and for open borders. It is for this reason that we need to educate as many people as possible, of all age groups, the freedoms promised to us in the Constitution. Because if we don’t truly understand the freedoms that it promises to us as citizens, then we will not fight to defend those freedoms. To get your free access today and to help us make sure that everyone in the conservative movement has refreshed their understanding of the Constitution this year, will you activate your free access by clicking this link today? If so, please use this link to activate your access to the guide today: **[https://secured.heritage.org/constitution/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z2e6qmil2ikbt3qts52qsr5lpl1cc6ilb909cdd0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie0or2cph2bs)** This resource has been hailed across the nation as an "outstanding Guide," which is why I consider it one of the finest resources Heritage has ever produced. I think you'll enjoy reading it, and I know you'll find use for it each day. With this powerful Guide in hand, you'll be ready to stand up to the far-Left and confidently defend the vision of our Founding Fathers. [**I hope you'll claim your copy today.**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zko02s58rsrd7nqd9lf99cacv0r8g2he2omd1auo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie0or2cph2bs) Thank you, Tony Johnson Director of Membership

name: Jen Kiggans
subject: Pictures from the scrapbook.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kiggans for Congress
body:
My name is Jen Kiggans, and I want to tell you a little bit about myself

| |
---
| | |
My name is Jen Kiggans, and I want to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm the Democrats #1 target.

In 2022, I defeated a liberal Democrat in one of the closest elections in the entire country to help Republicans retake the House of Representatives. They are already spending big bucks to try and defeat me, so I wanted to see if you would be willing to support our campaign.

But first, I wanted to tell you a little about myself and what led me to run for Congress in the first place.

---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z1bjku90oe231fdemloos80hmn6ncvhhpqeauo1g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie0or2cjh2bs)
---

That photo above is me and my husband, Steve. He is a retired F-18 pilot, and I'm a proud Navy wife and mother to four amazing children.

---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zc75kqag31p08o0seivra6j3cb2tgq0b1detjnq8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie0or2cjh2bs)
---

I also served in the Navy. That photo above is my helicopter with my call sign on it - "Blossom." I was winged as a naval aviator in 1995 and served our nation for a total of 10 years as a helicopter pilot flying H-46 and H-3 helicopters, completing two deployments to the Persian Gulf.

After serving in the Navy, I used my GI Bill benefits to go back to school and become a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. It was an honor to care for our Greatest Generation, and I helped them fight the system to get the healthcare they deserve.

---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zpfj0a99g8jj590e9h51214o8vjj3mas0mkrq778_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie0or2cjh2bs)
---

Over time, I got frustrated watching the evening news and just hearing about all the dysfunction and radical agendas in our government. But I'm not one to just complain about problems. I like to solve them.

_**So I got off my couch, and I ran for office.**_

---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zfrsbt5ljf33bc10rf5vmfqh21tmts7k8fih4su8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie0or2cjh2bs)
---

I served three sessions in the Virginia State Senate, where I used my real-world experience to actually solve problems. I was proud to champion legislation to promote election security, establish a Military Spouse Liaison, and advocate for patients, families, and caregivers in long-term care facilities.

Eventually, I realized a lot of the problems facing my family, our neighbors, and our community were actually coming from Washington. We were represented by a Democrat who voted with Nancy Pelosi 99% of the time, and I felt we needed a representative who would actually put our values and community first.

---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zuh41o729h8n8kfjrspcoa3esmqqaq6jprsi3leo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie0or2cjh2bs)
---

So, I once again decided to stop complaining and _actually do something about it_. So I ran for Congress!

When I commit to something, I give it my all, and that's what we did with the campaign. We were up against a lot. National Democrats poured over $10 million into my opponent's campaign, and big money PACs spent even more attacking me.

---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zjm7o7vk4dfdlp4gc7r5mrarc5d1ngbgjplfdrno_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie0or2cjh2bs)
---

But, we stayed focused on the task at hand and never lost sight of why I was running. On Election Night, we won by about 10,000 votes in one of the closest races in the entire nation.

And in Congress, we've already been able to make a big impact. **We are standing up for veterans, parents, taxpayers, and hard-working Americans.** We're making good progress, but the work is just getting started.

---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zroese130mbhoccuvvbl6j9n552qpg7da5okm350_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie0or2cjh2bs)
---

**But the Democrats and their deep pocket donors are already setting out to defeat me.** The Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee has announced my seat is one of their top targets in 2024, so I'm hoping you will donate today to help our campaign keep going strong.

---
| | [KEEP JEN IN THE FIGHT](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z501v2nkjgkbevj7u0gg2vfbj0ftnu4vvcvls520_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie0or2cjh2bs "DONATE TO JEN KIGGANS")
---

If you want to see more regular, everyday citizens in office instead of career politicians, then I need your urgent help. Can you spare anything to help me defeat the Democrats in this #1 Battleground race?

I can't stand sending messages like this. Sometimes I wonder what would have happened if I never got off the couch and ran for office...but then I remember that America is always worth protecting...no matter what!

Thanks for reading my message. I hope I was able to earn your support.

---
| | [DONATE NOW](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z9sro4eco7idjdq10751q2aqegq4rkubtikma7ng_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie0or2cjh2bs "DONATE TO JEN KIGGANS")
---

-Jen

They know if they flip Jen's seat, that they can retake the entire House Majority. _**We can 't let that happen!**_

body:
Friend, my team has emailed you about the fundraising deadline I'm facing on August 31st.

**[I'm not alone. Every single Republican Senator and Senate candidate is facing this deadline.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zbts0p27u6322ju2vg101v1rrdnr48d8p2oit5pg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie8pb4clh2bs)**

**[And for our nominees in battleground states, it could be a make or break moment.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zdj4mp777rj3q17pa1jjkgd55btldcf7l72q69sg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie8pb4clh2bs)**

**[That's why I'm asking you to split a donation between these candidates and my campaign ASAP.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zu7kh17o231oglcp4nmj7iuhl8usb99njbnq4ga0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie8pb4clh2bs)**

_**[Tim Sheehy, who served as a Navy Seal,](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2ze0ggkj028dmr4amld7gmjanb4bu60nubfjor25g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie8pb4clh2bs)**_ is running in Montana against Jon Tester.

_**[Dave McCormick, a fellow Army veteran,](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zjkulnl4nr6q8jlfpqmekj7uis41jig8fqod9sb0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie8pb4clh2bs)**_ is running in Pennsylvania against Bob Casey.

_**[Sam Brown, another fellow Army veteran,](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z9siose84guqqcgrvp1gl4euq26ikka8ai0fihbo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie8pb4clh2bs)**_ is running in Nevada against Jacky Rosen.

_**[Bernie Moreno, a proven business leader,](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zlrql3bk67h08ekjpkji4s7ejb7rdp1a81490uao_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie8pb4clh2bs)**_ is running in Ohio against Sherrod Brown.

_**[And Kari Lake, a tough conservative who will put America first,](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zsep8qq5gd4218v8o0kn85utk7rvem83gen5trp8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie8pb4clh2bs)**_ is running in Arizona.

********************************************************[SPLIT A DONATION HERE](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zh97vcmad34e6q0hcqdgnj4osrlrtfa6p2vomlto_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie8pb4clh2bs)************************************************** ******

If these tough conservatives win, it guarantees Republicans win the U.S. Senate.

And I need each of them there with me to stop the Marxist Left in its tracks, and to make America strong again.

**[A donation of any amount will go directly to their campaigns, and *any amount* will make a difference ahead of this critical marker.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zjgng7lb0t54fn0a5oqcns8vgs17m5h0jm356vb0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie8pb4clh2bs)**

As I've also said before, if we don't win in November, we're done. body:
My name is Jen Kiggans, and I want to tell you a little bit about myself

| |
---
| | |
My name is Jen Kiggans, and I want to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm the Democrats #1 target.

In 2022, I defeated a liberal Democrat in one of the closest elections in the entire country to help Republicans retake the House of Representatives. They are already spending big bucks to try and defeat me, so I wanted to see if you would be willing to support our campaign.

But first, I wanted to tell you a little about myself and what led me to run for Congress in the first place.

---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zivm7lkpppjn33vfps2ajt2obad4od8hda5h8r8g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie2oj6chh2bs)
---

That photo above is me and my husband, Steve. He is a retired F-18 pilot, and I'm a proud Navy wife and mother to four amazing children.

---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0v3e5lal3t0uji108v92mnhpjhkmltem1e787m0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie2oj6chh2bs)
---

I also served in the Navy. That photo above is my helicopter with my call sign on it - "Blossom." I was winged as a naval aviator in 1995 and served our nation for a total of 10 years as a helicopter pilot flying H-46 and H-3 helicopters, completing two deployments to the Persian Gulf.

After serving in the Navy, I used my GI Bill benefits to go back to school and become a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. It was an honor to care for our Greatest Generation, and I helped them fight the system to get the healthcare they deserve.

---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z5mtun5fqvdsho8jhqd67upea0tn8mnr1ict0n90_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie2oj6chh2bs)
---

Over time, I got frustrated watching the evening news and just hearing about all the dysfunction and radical agendas in our government. But I'm not one to just complain about problems. I like to solve them.

_**So I got off my couch, and I ran for office.**_

---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zdl3kskhin3e58jdqc5m8146nqssp1ql7eaklmk8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie2oj6chh2bs)
---

I served three sessions in the Virginia State Senate, where I used my real-world experience to actually solve problems. I was proud to champion legislation to promote election security, establish a Military Spouse Liaison, and advocate for patients, families, and caregivers in long-term care facilities.

Eventually, I realized a lot of the problems facing my family, our neighbors, and our community were actually coming from Washington. We were represented by a Democrat who voted with Nancy Pelosi 99% of the time, and I felt we needed a representative who would actually put our values and community first.

---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z7ahcmb4db6urqu35udj91ujt04t7f9ub7foe5g0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie2oj6chh2bs)
---

So, I once again decided to stop complaining and _actually do something about it_. So I ran for Congress!

When I commit to something, I give it my all, and that's what we did with the campaign. We were up against a lot. National Democrats poured over $10 million into my opponent's campaign, and big money PACs spent even more attacking me.

---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zse1jjh00qqptni2pst0d480tl1m0bn1t0t6nai0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie2oj6chh2bs)
---

But, we stayed focused on the task at hand and never lost sight of why I was running. On Election Night, we won by about 10,000 votes in one of the closest races in the entire nation.

And in Congress, we've already been able to make a big impact. **We are standing up for veterans, parents, taxpayers, and hard-working Americans.** We're making good progress, but the work is just getting started.

---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z6f84bplssqjf7s3ks2j6smbg736vbqselghuv10_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie2oj6chh2bs)
---

**But the Democrats and their deep pocket donors are already setting out to defeat me.** The Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee has announced my seat is one of their top targets in 2024, so I'm hoping you will donate today to help our campaign keep going strong.

---
| | [KEEP JEN IN THE FIGHT](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z136fvdvf70vhdr87rojofsdcq6qb27mkftonmkg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie2oj6chh2bs "DONATE TO JEN KIGGANS")
---

If you want to see more regular, everyday citizens in office instead of career politicians, then I need your urgent help. Can you spare anything to help me defeat the Democrats in this #1 Battleground race?

I can't stand sending messages like this. Sometimes I wonder what would have happened if I never got off the couch and ran for office...but then I remember that America is always worth protecting...no matter what!

Thanks for reading my message. I hope I was able to earn your support.

---
| | [DONATE NOW](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zn92ecljd7ki8lukgduo5k6b7aphpt3f0k9tl9jo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie2oj6chh2bs "DONATE TO JEN KIGGANS")
---

-Jen

Democrats are working overtime to DEFEAT Navy Veteran Jen Kiggans!

They know if they flip Jen's seat, that they can retake the entire House Majority. _**We can 't let that happen!**_

subject: “The Free Market is Dead”
body:

| |
Dear fellow American, Time magazine published a story featuring the headline, "The Free Market is Dead: What Will Replace It?"

This is, of course, an exaggeration, but it makes clear the far-Left's goal--nothing less than a transformation of the world economy based on a rejection of economist Adam Smith's "invisible hand."

As the author writes, "We are on the cusp of a new era of broad-based prosperity in which our leaders are poised to more actively manage the American market."

Today's advocates of a "managed market" may call it by a new name--"The Great Reset"--but it is premised on an old and harmful idea.

What utopian ideologies like this one have in common is a misplaced faith in the rule of so-called experts and a corresponding disregard for the people's right to rule themselves. Taken to their logical conclusion, such ideologies can end only in **tyranny**.

The great British statesman Winston Churchill knew this, which led him to observe, "Nothing would be more fatal than for the government of states to get into the hands of the experts. Expert knowledge is limited knowledge: and the unlimited ignorance of the plain man who knows only what hurts is a safer guide, than any vigorous direction of a specialised character."

**In the fight to preserve our freedom, our greatest asset is education.** Americans who understand our country's founding principles and have a firm grasp of history are best prepared to resist the lure of utopian schemes.

**[That's why Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in our FREE MARKET SURVEY.](http://trk.secureandprosper.)**

Your answers will help us understand more clearly the views of mainstream Americans--not the so-called experts--concerning the importance of the free market system in our nation.

Please begin your survey below. Your answers will remain strictly confidential.

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/free-market-survey/](http://trk.secureandprosper.)**

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: Liberty Under Threat
body:
We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zq1m40sra67ugjgmee6fm57bni234eof37247s0o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie2oj1cth2bs)
---
| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is **simply** and **clearly un-American**.

There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says _Imprimis_ is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month.

You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are **mailed to homes and businesses** ten times per year.

Our research also shows that _Imprimis_ subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving _Imprimis_ even greater reach and influence.

And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

Since _Imprimis_ launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.**

**But the fact that we offer _Imprimis_ free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing _Imprimis_ is without cost. **

Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of _Imprimis_ to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs.**

Your generous support today will help us reach our _Imprimis_ goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever!

That's why, in addition to _Imprimis_ , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. We're doing this through our **[Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zrjof4e6c0qc908m79gvjbdu82krsbkatfvprng0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie2oj1cth2bs).**

These efforts include:

* **Educating millions of Americans, especially younger Americans, through free online courses** —on topics including the Constitution, American history, and free-market economics.

* **Providing hundreds of thousands of young Americans with free copies of the Declaration of Independence and Constitution** —Hillsdale has already distributed over 600,000 free copies of these founding documents, and we receive more requests every week.

* **Educating thousands of K-12 students** in Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 public and private schools—there are already more than 90 such schools across the country, each having a strong curricular component in American civics.

I hope you'll agree that after everything we've seen in the last few years, the need for _Imprimis_ and Hillsdale's other educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

Hillsdale is the only college in America equipped to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans about our nation's great heritage of liberty and about the need to defend freedom and limited government.

Almost unique among American colleges and universities, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

**This independence from the government also means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

[ Will you give generously to our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions** --which includes expanding the reach and influence of _Imprimis_](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zhpqetqut9dls7smdg8puho9pjtpercptii71p18_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie2oj1cth2bs)?

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on American principles and the American way of life, please show your support for Hillsdale College with a generous tax-deductible gift today.

I hope you will stand with us as we engage the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, on the battlefield of education.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. Liberty in America is under threat, and education is the only long-term solution. That's why we are greatly expanding our national educational outreach, such as _Imprimis_ , free online courses, K-12 curricula and support, and much more. And we need your help to do so! Please make a generous, tax-deductible gift in support of liberty and education at this secure link: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/defend-liberty](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zpmc99ka9fitem43b7fbseb09v4217qralpsdi1g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie2oj1cth2bs)**.

Thank you again for saving young people through education.

name: Hillsdale College via Restore Our Nation
subject: Our nation’s history is unifying
body:
Hillsdale College has been engaging the Left on the battlefield of education

Hillsdale College | | | This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/0g-C5bEor3U7iiKFVAOmEw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoov5QP0S_~) Fellow American, [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/0g-C5bEor3U7iiKFVAOmEw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoov5QP0S_~) You may be discouraged by the Left’s dominance in our colleges and universities, and its increasing influence in K-12 education. But we must not lose hope. Instead, we must fight back with the truth. Hillsdale College has been engaging the Left on the battlefield of education from the beginning. That’s why we’ve turned our course, [**“The Great American Story: A Land of Hope”**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/0g-C5bEor3U7iiKFVAOmEw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoov5QP0S_~) into a DVD set, and I’d like you to have a copy. Taught by historian Wilfred McClay and based on his recently published history of America, **“The Great American Story: A Land of Hope”** presents a full, unbiased account of America’s past. Hillsdale’s goal in producing this course is to **restore the kind of intelligent patriotism—especially among our young people—that is essential to preserving free government.** **“The Great American Story: A Land of Hope”** is a powerful counterweight to _The New York Times’_ “1619 Project,” which is injecting the idea that America is an essentially unjust nation into the curricula of America’s K-12 schools. Please consider getting [**“The Great American Story: A Land of Hope”**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/0g-C5bEor3U7iiKFVAOmEw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoov5QP0S_~) as a DVD set for your home library or to give as a gift. Presenting real American history is the surest means of preserving liberty. Quantities are limited, so reserve your copy today. name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: Liberty Under Threat
body:
We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zeo6f3hdts6koud5gtfdbredu0q4aok7j5iirji8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie9or2cdh2bs)
---
| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is **simply** and **clearly un-American**.

There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says _Imprimis_ is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month.

You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are **mailed to homes and businesses** ten times per year.

Our research also shows that _Imprimis_ subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving _Imprimis_ even greater reach and influence.

And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

Since _Imprimis_ launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.**

**But the fact that we offer _Imprimis_ free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing _Imprimis_ is without cost. **

Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of _Imprimis_ to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs.**

Your generous support today will help us reach our _Imprimis_ goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever!

That's why, in addition to _Imprimis_ , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. We're doing this through our **[Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z156nl7ujbkved6ogo0ejgdr344q7e496s06dv40_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie9or2cdh2bs).**

These efforts include:

* **Educating millions of Americans, especially younger Americans, through free online courses** —on topics including the Constitution, American history, and free-market economics.

* **Providing hundreds of thousands of young Americans with free copies of the Declaration of Independence and Constitution** —Hillsdale has already distributed over 600,000 free copies of these founding documents, and we receive more requests every week.

* **Educating thousands of K-12 students** in Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 public and private schools—there are already more than 90 such schools across the country, each having a strong curricular component in American civics.

I hope you'll agree that after everything we've seen in the last few years, the need for _Imprimis_ and Hillsdale's other educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

Hillsdale is the only college in America equipped to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans about our nation's great heritage of liberty and about the need to defend freedom and limited government.

Almost unique among American colleges and universities, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

**This independence from the government also means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

[ Will you give generously to our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions** --which includes expanding the reach and influence of _Imprimis_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z305lt7a6412pha2n9pm4vt95koqqovlq8h4kgq8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie9or2cdh2bs)?

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on American principles and the American way of life, please show your support for Hillsdale College with a generous tax-deductible gift today.

I hope you will stand with us as we engage the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, on the battlefield of education.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. Liberty in America is under threat, and education is the only long-term solution. That's why we are greatly expanding our national educational outreach, such as _Imprimis_ , free online courses, K-12 curricula and support, and much more. And we need your help to do so! Please make a generous, tax-deductible gift in support of liberty and education at this secure link: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/defend-liberty](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4hbkp40q4ivl4l4qde72brv352nv9tkvqt1shc8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie9or2cdh2bs)**.

Thank you again for saving young people through education.
---
| |
---

American Action News
---
_PO Box 1177 Fort Collins, CO 80522_
_[**unsubscribe**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zv9ibbrvlrltpo6ovge047alo1hqfdjkfn9n247o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie9or2cdh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kuo72ttle5pq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnklprctbi6pr34t5i6krqfp9ls4o7et5hm6qbcsr7c0bjbd1km6pqcdtlmcibbp36c9g61ob6c8iv0)_ | _[manage data preferences](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z42b19s9eoneccgtmhj3nvv7fvuilk453gs2e120_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c3ie9or2cdh2bs)_

name: No Dem Left Behind
subject: The Power of Rural Democrats
body:
Local parties are coming together like never before to build a rural resurgence.
| | | | | |
---
# Rural Democrats Are Being Heard.
---
|
---
The pandemic changed so much for so many Americans. There are a few silver linings amongst those clouds. The world learned how to be more digitally connected and connected across great distances. Rural America is all about great distances. For years, political organizing was an insurmountable challenge in certain districts. Upon No Dem Left Behind's founding, we recognized that obstacle and had a plan to address it. Our early virtual town halls utilized celebrity star-power to spotlight Dems in deep-red districts. Our ROCC forums taught the principles of organizing in a peer-learning environment. Our work on ARPA inspired activism in Republican-led counties. In short, our mission was to connect and empower rural Democrats to build the infrastructure to reshape the Electoral Map in the years to come.
---
|
---
The lesson? After the rain, comes flowers.
---
|
---
It's a pleasure to have you with us in this ongoing journey. And that's how rural Democrats are feeling. Our reward at No Dem Left Behind comes when we step into that local Dems meeting, when we partner and accomplish something together, we get that great, big "thank you". Thanks for recognizing us, remembering us, and making sure we never feel left behind. If you can spare a little to support this work, we'd greatly appreciate it...
---

---
To tomorrow's field of flowers. — No Dem Left Behind

name: Hillsdale College via Restore Our Nation
subject: Liberty Under Threat
body:
We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/6dyfwmZWpAEoLs-RZFKNyg~~/AARclAA~~~)
---
| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is **simply** and **clearly un-American**.

There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says _Imprimis_ is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month.

You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are **mailed to homes and businesses** ten times per year.

Our research also shows that _Imprimis_ subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving _Imprimis_ even greater reach and influence.

And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

Since _Imprimis_ launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.**

**But the fact that we offer _Imprimis_ free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing _Imprimis_ is without cost. **

Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of _Imprimis_ to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs.**

Your generous support today will help us reach our _Imprimis_ goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever!

That's why, in addition to _Imprimis_ , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. We're doing this through our **[Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/6dyfwmZWpAEoLs-RZFKNyg~~/AARclAA~~~).**

These efforts include:

* **Educating millions of Americans, especially younger Americans, through free online courses** —on topics including the Constitution, American history, and free-market economics.

* **Providing hundreds of thousands of young Americans with free copies of the Declaration of Independence and Constitution** —Hillsdale has already distributed over 600,000 free copies of these founding documents, and we receive more requests every week.

* **Educating thousands of K-12 students** in Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 public and private schools—there are already more than 90 such schools across the country, each having a strong curricular component in American civics.

I hope you'll agree that after everything we've seen in the last few years, the need for _Imprimis_ and Hillsdale's other educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

Hillsdale is the only college in America equipped to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans about our nation's great heritage of liberty and about the need to defend freedom and limited government.

Almost unique among American colleges and universities, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

**This independence from the government also means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

[ Will you give generously to our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions** --which includes expanding the reach and influence of _Imprimis_](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/6dyfwmZWpAEoLs-RZFKNyg~~/AARclAA~~~)?

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on American principles and the American way of life, please show your support for Hillsdale College with a generous tax-deductible gift today.

I hope you will stand with us as we engage the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, on the battlefield of education.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. Liberty in America is under threat, and education is the only long-term solution. That's why we are greatly expanding our national educational outreach, such as _Imprimis_ , free online courses, K-12 curricula and support, and much more. And we need your help to do so! Please make a generous, tax-deductible gift in support of liberty and education at this secure link: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/defend-liberty](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/6dyfwmZWpAEoLs-RZFKNyg~~/AARclAA~~~)**.

Thank you again for saving young people through education.
---
| |
---

Restore Our Nation
