| | | Hello, As a fellow conservative, you likely already well know and feel the pressure that is being put upon you to abandon your principles by the progressives on the far left. You know that fighting back for what you believe in is the best thing to do. In these trying times, we conservatives must turn to the greatest document in the history of the world to promise freedom and opportunity to its citizens for guidance; **our Constitution.** That's why I'm writing today. I'd like to offer you the chance to gain **[free access to Heritage's Guide to the Constitution today to help you defend your principles against those on the far left.](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=bf74cfd32baa466d8c5622584c929d09&_e=uFvmiTUF6tDB-s9OtYtgkxJMlAOLsQJnp_z8JLhkxZhx1kajYQEmf4lbA66Q28-ttDQaOTWtGzAqzVY4Pq2nK5RknTI9pvS6plMAiZv5IdzcNPNEzzCoUnSmpjeJP5i6PiCDtkmjCVOndIuYCq3R9CsiogmMbQfIMZtcMWP840o-bzPgFSQqSTffees8vCxVgrrsCaV1qUYPiwYK8d4Iu9_NHLoAIN7ebqWv1iJx1GgjVwH-XZ_Clz0uubUIY7En6cY9Bc6mGNPjf5fnHRCsC5p0JCtcG5FWO9xHYfzil3urMNV4UkFY81t66SbOaMm2qo1Z1O34-_o4MSZ9jcHWo3jIr1S_73Mp9vtiWk0O5LQ%3D)** [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=bf74cfd32baa466d8c5622584c929d09&_e=uFvmiTUF6tDB-s9OtYtgkxJMlAOLsQJnp_z8JLhkxZhx1kajYQEmf4lbA66Q28-ttDQaOTWtGzAqzVY4Pq2nK5RknTI9pvS6plMAiZv5IdzcNPNEzzCoUnSmpjeJP5i6PiCDtkmjCVOndIuYCq3R9CsiogmMbQfIMZtcMWP840o-bzPgFSQqSTffees8vCxVgrrsCaV1qUYPiwYK8d4Iu0BOVEKZRu5rOFLYsIoJRtfqBj-X-IEpS5Wbw-Sl_B02IxhSvGtOktojAq0tTnH4aDai-oVP9zeVTd17RkexUbGbuM1DTZ16kv5Fpvvbljra4UalyRwtFXL8DsaSwM0KegMNKbyqvwO4k5RybyekjSQ%3D) In this free digital interactive guide, you'll find:
* **Useful, clause-by-clause analysis** of the entire Constitution and each amendment
* Input from more than **100 constitutional scholars and legal experts** including President Reagan's former Attorney Ed Meese
* **A thorough review** of what the Constitution actually says and how it applies today
* **A copy of the Constitution** and the documents that served as its foundation

This is a critical year in our nation's history. The country is polarized and divided on a great number of issues, and roughly half of the voting population is being swayed towards greater government control over our lives--they want government-controlled health care, higher taxes and redistribution of wealth in the form of socialism, increased regulations, to do away with the Electoral College, and for open borders. It is for this reason that we need to educate as many people as possible, of all age groups, the freedoms promised to us in the Constitution. Because if we don't truly understand the freedoms that it promises to us as citizens, then we will not fight to defend those freedoms. To get your free access today and to help us make sure that everyone in the conservative movement has refreshed their understanding of the Constitution this year, will you activate your free access by clicking this link today? If so, please use this link to activate your access to the guide today: **[https://secured.heritage.org/constitution/](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=bf74cfd32baa466d8c5622584c929d09&_e=uFvmiTUF6tDB-s9OtYtgkxJMlAOLsQJnp_z8JLhkxZhx1kajYQEmf4lbA66Q28-ttDQaOTWtGzAqzVY4Pq2nK5RknTI9pvS6plMAiZv5IdzcNPNEzzCoUnSmpjeJP5i6PiCDtkmjCVOndIuYCq3R9CsiogmMbQfIMZtcMWP840o-bzPgFSQqSTffees8vCxVgrrsCaV1qUYPiwYK8d4Iu8UjXG5UPCzTAk_PUs8r9L89vzAVDKnhBAUgEW3QK8WOBBD-OX0BUXNA8m5B36VEjtPz164mm69tWZenABaWJMGq56VHkjXEtEDhi1Ciq8u5G7O-kH9ousexxzF6vowZLFfLFQlZ34yLpffL7P12_eo%3D)** This resource has been hailed across the nation as an "outstanding Guide," which is why I consider it one of the finest resources Heritage has ever produced. I think you'll enjoy reading it, and I know you'll find use for it each day. name: Jenny Beth Martin, Tea Party Patriots Citizens Fund
subject: The Time is Now—Host a House Party for Trump!
body:
Rally your friends, get out the vote, and help secure Trump's victory from your own home on August 22nd!
| | | |
---
|
---
| Patriot-

---
| As you know, our country is at a crossroads, and the stakes couldn't be higher. Right now, Donald Trump does have the momentum to win, but only if we, his supporters, don't sit back and let it slip away. Every single action you take could be the difference between victory and defeat.
That's why I'm reaching out to you with an exciting opportunity to make a real impact. **We 're organizing ****[Re-elect Donald Trump House Parties](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a44bdb41/1edb9794a44b167d "https://forms.teapartypatriots.org/TPPatriots/form/Aug22ndDayofAction/formperma/O0fEnRLSzP8g3Tf04XW7DPQ2y8kp-Aw9ek-LUTxQpDk")**** across the nation on August 22, 2024, the very day Kamala Harris will take the stage at the DNC to accept her nomination.** While the mainstream media is busy trying to spin a story about her "momentum," we know the truth--Trump has it, but we need to act now to keep it.
I'm so fired up about this because it's a chance for us to come together, have some fun, and do something truly meaningful. We've made it super easy for you with a step-by-step guide that includes everything from sample invites to scripts you can use during the party, and more. You'll have everything you need to make your event a success, and your guests will leave fired up and ready to keep getting out the vote after your party ends.
Time is already running short. Early voting starts soon, and Georgia, a key state in this election, is hanging in the balance. If we don't win Georgia, the path to White House becomes much tougher. But if we rally now, we can secure the victory that America needs. The house parties will focus on Georgia for that reason.
**[Will you step up and host a house party on August 22nd?](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a44bdb41/1edb9794a44b167f "https://forms.teapartypatriots.org/TPPatriots/form/Aug22ndDayofAction/formperma/O0fEnRLSzP8g3Tf04XW7DPQ2y8kp-Aw9ek-LUTxQpDk")******
**Your** **decision to host a house party will ignite a fire in others to act,** and through patriots like you working hard and refusing to give up, **we can ensure that Donald Trump returns to the White House**.**
****Let 's make history together!** ****
---
| In liberty,
Jenny Beth Martin

name: Douglas Carswell
subject: Why the Mississippi education ‘miracle’ is a myth
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/educationstandards-11572968?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend, **In order to fix a problem, you first need to accept that you’ve got a problem.**

In order for families in our state to get the education their children deserve, we need state leaders to recognize that right now they aren't getting a good enough education.

**Instead, what we get is propaganda about the Mississippi education ‘miracle’. **
---
|
---
| This week the Mississippi Department of Education published the results from the 2023-24 Mississippi Academic Assessment Program (MAAP). **Relying on this data to tell you about education in Mississippi would be like leaving it to your child to mark their own homework.**

Sure enough, having marked their own homework, the Mississippi education bureaucracy told us that “student achievement has reached an all-time high” in math, English and science.

**Just as you get inflation in the economy, you get grade inflation in the education system.** MAAP scores are used to help rate schools and districts A-F. There has been a dramatic fall in the number of D and F rated districts in recent years. This is not because those districts are no longer failing, but because even failing districts get given better grades.

**A more credible measure of student performance is the national benchmark, the National Assessment of Educational Progress (NAEP).** This data tells a less flattering story.

* **4 in 10 fourth graders would struggle to read this sentence. In 2022, they could not reach even the _basic_ reading standard.**
* **82 percent of 8 th grade kids in Mississippi were not proficient math in 2022. **
* **69 percent of 4 th grade kids in Mississippi were not proficient in reading in 2022.**

**Education standards are bad - and __they are not getting better!__**

The claim by the Mississippi Department of Education that Mississippi “students have made faster progress than nearly every other state” is ridiculous.
---
|
---
_Mississippi Department of Silly~~Walks~~ Statistics? _
| The truth is that during the COVID lockdowns, standards as measured by the NAEP plummeted in other states, but barely changed in ours. This meant our relative position rose, but without any significant improvement in outcomes.

**Officials know all this, yet still present a misleading picture of what has happened in the belief that you will be impressed.**

Equally implausible is the idea that we should celebrate record high school graduation rates.

**One in four Mississippi public school students is chronically absent from school.** Worse, the number of kids regularly not showing up to school has skyrocketed from 70,275 in 2016-17 to 108,310 in 2022-23.

Honesty about the true state of education matters because self-congratulatory propaganda is one reason things don't get fixed.

**Mississippi has been run by supposed conservatives for over a decade**. In all that time, we have seen remarkably little progress towards the kind of big strategic changes we need.

**In 12 months, Arkansas, Alabama and Louisiana made more progress towards school choice than Mississippi managed in 12 years. Why?**
---
|
---
_Education reform takes vision_
| A lot of it is down to leadership. **Politicians merely looking to progress along the conveyor belt don’t need any vision.** They simply aim to “go along to get along”.

**Mississippi is now surrounded on three sides by states that have universal school choice. In every case, change took courage and vision, not self-congratulation.**

One of the reasons why Arkansas’ Sarah Huckabee Sanders, Louisiana’s Jeff Landry and Texas’ Greg Abbott are regularly on Fox News and are emerging as conservative leaders with a national profile is because they have shown the tenacity to fight for school choice in their own states.
---
|
---
_It can be done: Governor Sarah Huckabee Sanders signs into law universal school choice._
| **Another part of the problem is that too many have an interest in exaggerating the impact of those reforms that have happened.** This may be understandable, but laws passed almost a decade ago are not enough to improve education outcomes today.

**Our job at MCPP is to push forward conservative policies based on true conservative principles, not dubious press releases. **

We aim to ensure that conservative leaders in this state finally commit to universal school choice. We are on a mission to ensure that anyone telling you that there has been an education ‘miracle’ looks ridiculous. Only school choice will do.
---
|
---
_He believes in the education ‘miracle’. _
| Have an awesome weekend!
---

---
| |
---
Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell

subject: I will not be deterred
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TEAM KENNEDY
body:
It is in the name of that beauty that I run to be your next president.

|
---
| | | | [**It is in the name of that beauty that I run to be your next president.**](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=personal_8_16_nd1rs&n=1)

[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=personal_8_16_nd1rs&n=2)

[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=personal_8_16_nd1rs&n=3)
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=personal_8_16_nd1rs&n=4)
---
|
---
Dear Peter,
During my announcement speech more than a year ago, I said that I have so many skeletons in the closet that if they could vote, I would be king of the world. I knew much would be made of my past. I have been around politics. I know of its hazards.
I also knew that my vision and policies would inspire resistance in the establishment.
When you _declare yourself foe to widespread corporate-government corruption and declare yourself opposed to a runaway war machine_ (a war machine killing innocents and draining our country’s coffers), you will inspire resistance in the establishment. Put another way, many powerful people want to make sure the gravy train never stops. And I derail gravy trains.
When you point out the morbidity of our two-party system -- a system that our first president warned us about, a system that is now largely predicated on hating fellow humans -- **you will inspire resistance in the establishment.**
When you’ve spent much of your life successfully fighting against our biggest corporations and worst polluters; fighting against mining, timber, hydroelectricity, and oil industries on behalf of the voiceless and the indigenous; fighting against agribusiness barons blithely ravaging the lives of small farmers and small towns, you will inspire resistance in the establishment.
When you remind Americans that censorship and other curtailments of our civil liberties always arrive burnished with a moral and patriotic gloss, you will inspire resistance in the establishment.
When you invoke our crisis of meaning, our deaths of despair, the addiction, and the many children lost to screens, ill health, you will inspire resistance in the establishment.
When you are wary of reductive partisan ideology and group-think; and when you refuse the common coin of today’s public discourse -- a glib second-rate cruelty delivered via the screen -- you will inspire resistance in the establishment.
When you assert that to better our country we must work toward a politics that heals this divide and affirms our mutual belonging, you will inspire resistance in the establishment.
---
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=personal_8_16_nd1rs&n=5)
---
As you perhaps know, I am used to such resistance -- used to the bile and malign distortions that accompany speaking out on high-stakes issues. And I know that the establishment’s treatment of me -- while challenging -- makes perfect sense.
The dark and elaborately refined arts of partisan politics deployed to end my campaign (the documented censorship and shadowbanning; the out-in-the-open, anti-democratic, and well-funded attempts to keep me off ballots through expensive, complex, time-consuming legal challenges; the thwarting of debate access; the withholding of secret service protection; the paid staged protests; the sundry campaigns of defamation and scandalmongering) are the logical reactions of a threatened -- and very unwell -- status quo.
And underneath all of this -- underneath much of this election cycle, underneath much of this moment in our nation’s politics -- is a sort of destitution. A destitution of heart. It’s no small wonder so many people have withdrawn from civic life and democracy altogether.
**A broken bond needs to be reestablished in our country. We need more soul-searching and less partisan warfare.**
Our work as Americans, whether we like it or not, transcends all labels and all parties. It seems we will recognize this reality and act accordingly; or be broken into it. History is not made occasionally on great stages by the privileged few but made daily in the depths of each human soul. Ours is a beautiful nation, still.
According to the Internet, our country (and our world) is in chaos. But in post offices, parks, and grocery stores our beauty still heartens and shines. We all see it every day. It is in the name of that beauty that I work.
It is in the name of that beauty that I run to be your next president.
**The true power of America is not its comfort, wealth, or military might, but its ideals of liberty, democracy, and generosity.**

clean_body: It is in the name of that beauty that I run to be your next president. | | | | | | | Dear Peter, During my announcement speech more than a year ago, I said that I have so many skeletons in the closet that if they could vote, I would be king of the world. I knew much would be made of my past. I have been around politics. I know of its hazards. I also knew that my vision and policies would inspire resistance in the establishment. When you declare yourself foe to widespread corporate-government corruption and declare yourself opposed to a runaway war machine (a war machine killing innocents and draining our country’s coffers), you will inspire resistance in the establishment. Put another way, many powerful people want to make sure the gravy train never stops. And I derail gravy trains. When you point out the morbidity of our two-party system -- a system that our first president warned us about, a system that is now largely predicated on hating fellow humans -- you will inspire resistance in the establishment. When you’ve spent much of your life successfully fighting against our biggest corporations and worst polluters; fighting against mining, timber, hydroelectricity, and oil industries on behalf of the voiceless and the indigenous; fighting against agribusiness barons blithely ravaging the lives of small farmers and small towns, you will inspire resistance in the establishment. When you remind Americans that censorship and other curtailments of our civil liberties always arrive burnished with a moral and patriotic gloss, you will inspire resistance in the establishment. When you invoke our crisis of meaning, our deaths of despair, the addiction, and the many children lost to screens, ill health, you will inspire resistance in the establishment. When you are wary of reductive partisan ideology and group-think; and when you refuse the common coin of today’s public discourse -- a glib second-rate cruelty delivered via the screen -- you will inspire resistance in the establishment. When you assert that to better our country we must work toward a politics that heals this divide and affirms our mutual belonging, you will inspire resistance in the establishment. As you perhaps know, I am used to such resistance -- used to the bile and malign distortions that accompany speaking out on high-stakes issues. And I know that the establishment’s treatment of me -- while challenging -- makes perfect sense. The dark and elaborately refined arts of partisan politics deployed to end my campaign (the documented censorship and shadowbanning; the out-in-the-open, anti-democratic, and well-funded attempts to keep me off ballots through expensive, complex, time-consuming legal challenges; the thwarting of debate access; the withholding of secret service protection; the paid staged protests; the sundry campaigns of defamation and scandalmongering) are the logical reactions of a threatened -- and very unwell -- status quo. And underneath all of this -- underneath much of this election cycle, underneath much of this moment in our nation’s politics -- is a sort of destitution. A destitution of heart. It’s no small wonder so many people have withdrawn from civic life and democracy altogether. A broken bond needs to be reestablished in our country. We need more soul-searching and less partisan warfare. Our work as Americans, whether we like it or not, transcends all labels and all parties. It seems we will recognize this reality and act accordingly; or be broken into it. History is not made occasionally on great stages by the privileged few but made daily in the depths of each human soul. Ours is a beautiful nation, still. According to the Internet, our country (and our world) is in chaos. But in post offices, parks, and grocery stores our beauty still heartens and shines. We all see it every day. It is in the name of that beauty that I work. It is in the name of that beauty that I run to be your next president. The true power of America is not its comfort, wealth, or military might, but its ideals of liberty, democracy, and generosity. This campaign is about honoring and restoring those ideals -- regardless of the defamation, evasion, and trickery. We knew those were coming. We will not be deterred on this necessary journey. | Please let me hear from you right now. Take action. Tell your friends and neighbors. Together, we can rebuild America. | | Sincerely, Robert F. clean_body: Defeat Democrat Adam Schiff | | | | | | | Friend, I just wanted to say thank you – thank you for opening this email. . . . Because I know that your inbox is probably . . . Because I know that your inbox is probably crowded with so many political emails, emails about the state of our country and the numerous important elections that are happening right now. And more importantly, I know that you are busy with a life of your own, a family of your own, and daily trials and joys of your own. So, I hope you know that taking a minute out of your day to read about my critical battle to defeat Democrat Adam Schiff and fight for the future of California means the world to me. Friend, I hope you’ll and stay up to date through election day. We have less than 3 months to go, and so much is at stake. If you care about the future of California and the fight to bring common sense leadership to our country’s most left-wing state like I do, the greatest thing you can do is pray for me and my election. And Friend, in addition to your prayers, if you’re able, goes a long way towards helping me fight against Adam Schiff and the Democrat machine backing his campaign. Because the last thing the Democrats want to see is support from hundreds of individual American patriots donating to my campaign and dreaming of a new Conservative California. So, I’m glad this email reached you, and I hope I can count on your support to defeat Adam Schiff in November. | | | | | | | Thank you for your support. President Trump: "Nancy Dahlstrom is a Winner"
*|MC_PREVIEW_TEXT|*

View this email in your browser

<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=71270&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC

August 17, 2024
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
CONTACT: Houston Keene
press@nancyforalaska.com

President Trump: "Nancy Dahlstrom is a Winner"

ANCHORAGE, AK - With only a few days left until the primary election,
Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom is campaigning across Alaska in an effort
to get her message out to as many voters as she can.

<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=71270&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=64525> Just this weekend she has been to Kodiak
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=71270&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=64526> , Kenai, and the Alaska State Fair. She
has met with wonderful Alaskans
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=71270&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=64527> from Fairbanks
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=71270&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=64528> to Ketchikan to Kenai
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=71270&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=64525> and beyond
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=71270&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=64529> this summer, hearing their concerns and
sharing how she will work in Congress to reimplement President Donald
J. Trump's policies that kept America safe, secure, and prosperous. As
Alaskans head to the polls for the primary election, there's a question
that they should ask themselves: who is the best person to represent
their values in Washington? The answer is Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom
and President Trump knows it, as he reminded Alaskans on Truth Social
this morning
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=71270&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=64530> :

<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=71270&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=64530>

"With only a few days left until the primary election, I'm encouraging
Alaskans to get out and make their voices heard. This election is our
time to come together and show that we want real, conservative
leadership in Congress," Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom said in a
statement. "I look forward to bringing that leadership to Washington
and working with President Trump to Make America Great Again!"

Peter, I don’t know if you saw the news, but New York City District Attorney _Alvin Bragg decided that the Columbia students who violently seized control of the school, destroyed property, and physically intimidated Jewish students will not face criminal charges._

Alvin Bragg doesn’t appear to think they did anything wrong. As a result, these hateful left-wing protesters will not see the inside of a courtroom.

Because while DA Bragg hopes everyone forgets, TFAS student journalists will ensure that we continue to expose the crimes of the left-wing protestors. But they cannot do it alone. Hey Peter, it’s Lucas Kunce.
It’s been a busy few weeks on the campaign trail — we’ve traveled to every corner of the state, launched our first major TV ads, and won our primary election to take on Josh Hawley this November. Now, it’s full steam ahead to the General Election.
The energy I’m seeing on the ground is real and exciting. **So today, I wanted to take a quick moment to share some photos with you of what I’ve seen across Missouri these last few weeks:**

I first met Sam Brown in the burn unit. He'd just returned from Afghanistan where he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban. He was injured by a roadside bomb and had a long road to recovery. I was assigned as his dietitian in rehab and was very impressed by him. Here was a young man terribly injured while serving his country, but his heart was full of faith. He fought with every fiber of his being to recover so he could return to serve with his men in Afghanistan. And even when it became clear that he would never be permitted to return to the line of duty on account of his injuries, he didn't skip a beat. Sam had to relearn everything. He had prepared for his entire life to spend his career fighting for his country in the military. After his life plans were dashed in just 60 seconds, he re-focused his vision on serving others in a new way. Before we were married, and before we were even dating, Sam and I became friends. I shared with him some of the struggles I had faced, and he was honest with me. He was concerned for my Salvation – and for that matter so was I. He challenged me to reconnect with God and start going to church again. As he and I grew closer, he helped me rediscover my faith. Now here we are 15 years later. We have 3 kids, I'm a Bible-believing momma, and Sam is running for Senate to keep serving our nation and restore hope, leadership, and accountability. I'm endlessly grateful that God put him in my life. Sam is a warrior, a hero, a leader. _**[I'm backing this Purple Heart veteran all the way and I hope you will too.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=5970deb245f4401d9358e9b01dd68ae0&_e=ZlQN1ymlsjQTX0drUpbtLw72mbNAQhB3YtSq4-8oRxSCKeCtkhmq6kbG-ovA5tl3OZRGPqi-7U9I-3yQ4Cur9_-rxSNEn8YwkQq1GDlaCoGRmpURTl5wLvN9B3Yt24IkntcRwLkr8fBHS2Fs5kqJMMoYBnlC2VsUxnTrUgXSEuTjh7lXkMCHHc19eIHpbkgyxnkPJ3dCrDCM83e3ergFDAxSgj5ddbG7QwOLQyQkD8T7PH1KG5e3E_2qmieSX9eqPmyLxAUe3kLen3X-ZSAjCiIjXLs2Vms_QNM6mNlTkBGojIj_L1uKLIsqgPbOPJAHQHY5gzOLFKhy81zws2YW0K9exW634wVvhlisrGsuChjrd3fkLm-mqhEVKGgPJ0fSwYD5aseizz2VjNNspnTxVk2gjATusGVsORS3wCX9xa6mdygt_i8o409vtft_UMMG)**_

It's clear their left-wing donor base is as motivated as ever to stop conservatives from regaining Congress and the White House. We're falling behind, and we MUST step it up if we're going to restore America First leadership to secure our borders, keep us safe, lower inflation, and defend our freedoms & values. My request today is a simple one: If you, fellow patriot , along with everyone else here can do just that today, it would significantly impact our ability to broaden our reach and get past the Democrats' messaging blockade. - there's a lot at stake, and this is all I am asking today. Thank you, Bernie Moreno GOP Nominee for Senate, Ohio Meet Bernie Moreno: | Bernie Moreno fights for the American Dream because he’s lived it. Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18. Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America. In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board. After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation. Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First. Ohioans are done with politicians who talk a big game and do nothing. Bernie wants to go to D.C. to get work done – just like he always has. | **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

When I was 14, my family came to America to seek a better life. We arrived here with big dreams for the future. But those early days were hard. I remember my mom working back-to-back double shifts and _still_ struggling to afford rent for our small, one room apartment.
**So, after I turned 15, I got a job working the early morning shift at a local doughnut shop.** It was just a minimum wage job, but the small checks I brought home gave my family room to breathe. Finally, after a lot of hard work, the possibilities that we could only dream of before became reality.
We were able to move out of that one room apartment, and I got a scholarship to an incredible college. Eventually, I found a career path where I could give back to the communities and country that gave me so much. That call to service took me to places I had never even dreamed of before. **I became the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and now, I'm running for the United States Senate.**
**Making doughnuts in the morning before homeroom brought me all the way to Congress. ****I've seen time and time again how small acts have the power to create big, transformative change._And that's exactly how we're going to win this campaign in November._**
[**That's why I'm asking you to chip in just $10 — about the cost of a dozen doughnuts — to send me to the Senate. clean_body: after I turned 15, I got a job working the early morning shift at a local doughnut shop | | | Friend, I wanted to reach out this morning because we have an important deadline coming up. I'm about to ask you to help me hit my $3 million pre-Primary fundraising goal. But first, I want to tell you a story about doughnuts — and how they're going to help us save our Senate majority. = = When I was 14, my family came to America to seek a better life. We arrived here with big dreams for the future. But those early days were hard. I remember my mom working back-to-back double shifts and still struggling to afford rent for our small, one room apartment. So, after I turned 15, I got a job working the early morning shift at a local doughnut shop. It was just a minimum wage job, but the small checks I brought home gave my family room to breathe. Finally, after a lot of hard work, the possibilities that we could only dream of before became reality. We were able to move out of that one room apartment, and I got a scholarship to an incredible college. Eventually, I found a career path where I could give back to the communities and country that gave me so much. That call to service took me to places I had never even dreamed of before. I became the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and now, I'm running for the United States Senate. Making doughnuts in the morning before homeroom brought me all the way to Congress. Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."
---
[](http://trk.libertyledger.)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It 's clear to us that what the censors want is submission. **They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and stop fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They're asking us if we're willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](http://trk.libertyledger.)**** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---
[**YES, I'LL STAND WITH THE BEE**](http://trk.libertyledger.-NxNTfMIrfg)
---
Thanks for standing with us. We will continue to stand with you. Sincerely,Seth Dillon
CEO, The Babylon Bee

# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=3898%2E552475%2ERIlu6U)
Today is our opponent David McCormick’s birthday, so we’ve been thinking about some ways we should celebrate.
We thought about getting him a gift, but he probably doesn’t need anything new after he made millions investing in China’s military as the CEO of the world’s largest hedge fund.
Throwing him a party would be difficult, considering he lives 3.5 hours away in a mansion on Connecticut’s “gold coast.”
At the very least, he can enjoy a cold beer, like the Pennsylvania classic “Yangling,” as he calls it.
Above all, what we think David McCormick would enjoy the most is to go back to his hedge fund executive life in Connecticut and stop pretending like he lives in Pennsylvania.
[**So help David McCormick celebrate his birthday by chipping in $5 or more to Bob Casey’s campaign, and let’s keep Bob Casey, a real Pennsylvanian, in the Senate.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240817-1?refcode=em20240817-1&&refcode2=3898_552475_RIlu6U&akid=3898%2E552475%2ERIlu6U)
Thank you,
— Team Casey

clean_body: Inside: Our latest updates, new merch, and volunteer opportunities → | | | Peter, We’re coming off another incredible week on the campaign trail, with Vice President Kamala Harris and Governor Tim Walz traveling across the country to meet with voters and introduce themselves as the 2024 Democratic ticket. Kamala and Tim are ready to fight for working people and move America into the future -- but they can’t do it alone. They need every member of this team to do their part to make sure they win the White House come November. | | | ON THE CAMPAIGN TRAIL: THE ERAS TOUR (KAMALA AND TIM’S VERSION) The dynamic duo of Vice President Harris and Governor Walz got right to work last week, hitting the road on a battleground states tour and rallying support in Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Michigan, Arizona, and Nevada. Tens of thousands of energized voters showed up to rallies in these critical battleground states, while grassroots support poured in online. In the first 24 hours with Walz on the ticket, our team raised $36 million. That comes on top of key endorsements from LULAC Adelante PAC, UAW, UNITE HERE, The Culinary Union, and even Republicans for Harris. Team Harris-Walz is gaining support from a broad coalition of voters and organizations that represent the communities that will decide this election. They’ll keep fighting for all Americans and our fundamental freedoms this November. DON’T MISS THIS: PROJECT 2025 IS AT THE TOP OF TRUMP’S AGENDA It’s never been more clear: We can’t let the Trump-Vance Project 2025 agenda prevail in November. We are not going back. Just last week, in a rambling, hourlong press conference, Donald Trump left the door open to using the FDA to wipe out access to medication abortion, which would effectively ban abortion nationwide. Already, women across the country are suffering because of the nightmare Donald Trump unleashed by overturning Roe v. Wade. Things will only get worse if Trump wins again and wipes out access to medication abortion. Reminder -- as if we needed one -- there is only one ticket in this race fighting to protect our fundamental freedoms: Vice President Kamala Harris and Governor Tim Walz. name: Ruben Gallego
subject: A pretty wild story, if you have a minute
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
#

Hola, Peter. It’s Ruben.
You might be wondering how this kid...
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-august24.kZit_I&refcode=em240817-1-90&t=1&akid=2886%2E734936%2E_c8YZA)
...ended up here, running for U.S. Senate, in one of the most competitive races in the entire country.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-august24.kZit_I&refcode=em240817-1-90&t=2&akid=2886%2E734936%2E_c8YZA)
Well, it started back in the apartment I shared with my mom and my sisters. It was tough. I was sleeping on the floor because that’s all we could afford.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-august24.kZit_I&refcode=em240817-1-90&t=3&akid=2886%2E734936%2E_c8YZA)
I knew I had to do whatever it took to build a better life for us. I worked a bunch of jobs all through school to help make ends meet.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-august24.kZit_I&refcode=em240817-1-90&t=4&akid=2886%2E734936%2E_c8YZA)
Thanks to my family, my community, and a lot of hard work, I got into Harvard. But before I graduated, I enlisted in the Marines to serve the country that gave me so much.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-august24.kZit_I&refcode=em240817-1-90&t=5&akid=2886%2E734936%2E_c8YZA)
I deployed to al Anbar, Iraq with my brothers in arms. They called us “Lucky Lima”, but our luck turned eventually. We ended up the hardest hit Marine unit of the entire Iraq war, and I lost some of my best friends over there.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-august24.kZit_I&refcode=em240817-1-90&t=6&akid=2886%2E734936%2E_c8YZA)
You’re never the same person after something like that. And I knew I had to do something to improve things for the guys I served with, for people who grew up like me. So, I ended up running for Congress — and I won.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-august24.kZit_I&refcode=em240817-1-90&t=7&akid=2886%2E734936%2E_c8YZA)
Then, on January 6th, everything changed. It became clear to me that public service wasn’t just about improving the lives of the people in my community anymore — it was about defending our democracy, too.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-august24.kZit_I&refcode=em240817-1-90&t=8&akid=2886%2E734936%2E_c8YZA)
So now, I’m running for U.S. Senate. My opponent Kari Lake continues to spread the same lies and conspiracies that caused January 6th in the first place, and she’s one of the greatest threats to our democracy — after Trump himself.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-august24.kZit_I&refcode=em240817-1-90&t=9&akid=2886%2E734936%2E_c8YZA)
Back when I was that kid sleeping on the floor of our apartment, I never would’ve guessed this is how things would turn out.
When I was a Marine in Iraq, I never would’ve thought I’d have to fight to defend our democracy at home.
When I launched my first campaign, I never would’ve imagined that hundreds of thousands of people would back me up and donate to support me, either.
And I never, ever would’ve thought I’d need to ask supporters like you, people who have already done so much, to do a bit more. But to defeat Kari Lake and win in Arizona, that’s what I have to do.
I need you to do a bit more.
[**Please — if you can afford to make a donation of $5 or anything you can to my campaign, it would mean the world to me. The Democratic National Convention is right around the corner, and we’ve got a ton of progress to make on our goals between now and then.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-august24.kZit_I&refcode=em240817-1-90&t=10&akid=2886%2E734936%2E_c8YZA)

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

As you may know, the upcoming Senate race in New Mexico is paramount to Republicans. Securing this seat is crucial for a new GOP Senate majority that will be strong enough to deliver results for the American people. Nella Domenici is the candidate who can lead us to victory. Nella is a successful businesswoman and a principled fighter who has put this seat in play in 2024—something the Democrats never expected. This is our chance, friend, to tip the scales in our favor and provide a much-needed check on the radical left’s extreme agenda and President Joe Biden’s unchecked power. Crime is through the roof, over 10 million illegal aliens have flooded our border since Joe Biden became president, and inflation is crushing lower and middle-class families. Americans are suffering under their extreme and oppressive agenda,and I’ve had enough. This race is not just about New Mexico; it’s about the future of our country. We cannot afford to let the radical left run rampant with their destructive policies any longer. She’s a strong, principled fighter that I would be honored to have working alongside me in the Senate. But I need your help to get her there first. So please, don’t wait. Your support NOW is critical to our fight to save America. Thank you for your support. Senator Ron Johnson | ABOUT NELLA New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. Donald Trump and his MAGA cronies want full control of the government, the courts, and your life. That is why they created Trump’s Project 2025, which is a playbook designed to make that happen, __and we have to stop it.__

**Here is a look at their agenda:**

❌ Restrict abortion nationwide and enact government surveillance of pregnancy.

❌ Restrict access to birth control and contraception and access to fertility treatments like IVF.

❌ Silence or attack Donald Trump’s political enemies.

❌ Defund law enforcement.

❌ Raise costs for the middle class while giving a massive tax cut to the ultra-wealthy.

❌ Make prescription drugs more expensive for working families.

❌ Threaten health care coverage for millions of Americans.

Peter,
It’s official: reproductive rights will be on the ballot in November.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perelesformissouri24?refcode=amendment3_image [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perelesformissouri24?refcode=amendment3_image]
Amendment 3 will overturn Missouri’s total ban on abortion by guaranteeing a constitutional right to an abortion until fetal viability (around 24 weeks). After viability, the amendment allows for a better-defined exception for abortions needed when the life or health of the mother is at risk. Amendment 3 will also establish a patient’s right to make decisions about reproductive healthcare, including contraception, without governmental interference.
This is fantastic news, but we absolutely must have more Democratic voices of sanity, common sense, and respect for democracy in the State Senate to ensure that this measure is enacted with no political gamesmanship or cynical attempts to undermine these (and other) fundamental rights.
The extremists who have dominated the Missouri Senate have shown time and again that they cannot be trusted to do the right thing, even when the people speak with one voice, loudly and clearly. We must also defeat them at the ballot box —and the path to doing this requires us to win my race in Senate District 15 and flip this seat red to blue .
I will work for a better future for everyone in Missouri, and will protect and respect the will of the people. And I am asking if you will help me do this, Peter. #

**And what if I told you that your support really, truly matters.** Seriously. I’ve seen what this team can do, and on the first day of the general election with less than 100 days to go until the most important election of our lifetime, your donation is absolutely critical to our success.

12 years ago, the first DACA applications started being accepted | | | Hi Peter, We just marked the 12th anniversary of the first day of DACA. name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Do you have a story about how a pet has touched your life?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Some people take advantage of the bonds we share with our pets to turn a profit.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2314%2E4032634%2EazI39E)
---
To say that pets have a special place in our hearts would be the understatement of the century. Back in 2018, Bruce and I got a puppy at a time when it made no sense. We were heartbroken by the loss of our previous golden retriever, Otis, I was traveling back-and-forth from Massachusetts to Washington for work, and Bruce had a full-time job. But then, one day, Bruce just said, “We’re getting a dog. The heart wants what the heart wants.” And I’m so glad he knows about the things my heart wants. We named him Bailey, after George Bailey from _It’s a Wonderful Life._ | [](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-pepets/?source=EMZ22F_PEQ_E_20240816_V1S1&t=8&akid=2314%2E4032634%2EazI39E)
---

From family to family, from dogs and cats to hamsters and guinea pigs to birds and lizards and everything in between, pets add an extra shine to childhood memories. They soften the edges of a hard day. They teach us about love, care, and what we’re capable of.
Pet owners will drop everything for their furry (or feathery, or scaly, or hypoallergenic-ally hairless) friends.
But some people take advantage of the bonds we share with our pets to turn a profit.
I’m talking about corporate greed in private equity — and how it’s taking over more and more of the veterinary care industry.
Over the past decade, private equity firms have spent billions on buying up veterinary practices and then looting the profits while reducing quality of care, increasing prices for pet owners, and making working conditions even harder for veterinarians.
Veterinarians at private equity-owned practices have reported being overworked and pressured to upsell patients on expensive tests and procedures. At some practices, corporate managers require clinicians to meet demanding quotas for certain procedures, tying their income to the amount of revenue that they generate.
Private equity firms have also raised the cost of veterinary services, exploiting consumers’ love for their pets to make a profit. Since 2014, prices for veterinary services have risen by 60%, with prices well over $300 per visit.
I’m fighting back. Alongside Senator Richard Blumenthal of Connecticut, I just sent a letter to JAB — a private equity firm that’s notorious for snapping up small veterinary practices — calling for answers on its veterinary practices and operations.
We’re also urging the FTC and Congress to take stronger action against consolidation in the veterinary care industry, including by passing my Stop Wall Street Looting Act.
**I’m going to stay on this and fight from the heart for pet owners across America.**

name: Sarah McBride
subject: For LGBTQ+ folks, our very sense of belonging is on the line.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
We know that Kamala will be a leader on equality, just like she has always been throughout her career.
#
I recently joined an LGBTQ+ Unity call with the Human Rights Campaign’s "Out for Kamala" initiative.
I was truly moved by the enthusiasm and support for Kamala’s campaign from the LGBTQ+ community. We know that she will be a leader on LGBTQ+ issues, just like she has always been throughout her career.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240817-1?refcode=em20240817-1&refcode2=1023_21716_JPL9je&akid=1023%2E21716%2EJPL9je)
On the other hand, we’re also well aware that Donald Trump, J.D. Vance, and the MAGA GOP’s Project 2025 will spend the next five years fomenting violent culture wars. **We can’t risk four more years of Donald Trump and a return to the problems of the past, like hatred, divisiveness, and dangerous levels of anti-LGBTQ+ fervor.**
Democrats need to _SWEEP_ the November elections to not only move the public conversation beyond the hatred from the other side but to move equality forward in a meaningful way. For LGBTQ+ folks, our very sense of belonging is on the line.
**I am running for Congress, and if elected, I’ll be the first-ever openly transgender member of that chamber. I am ready to be a voice for our community and for so many people across Delaware and the nation who are ready to fight back.**
[**I’m _so_ excited about Kamala and her running mate, Tim Walz, but I also know that with so much on the line in this election, we have a very important and serious task ahead of us. Can you split a donation of $5 between Kamala Harris and my campaign for Congress?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240817-1?refcode=em20240817-1-1023&amount=5&refcode2=1023_21716_JPL9je&akid=1023%2E21716%2EJPL9je)

Friend,
I want to take a moment to tell you about my path to becoming a United States Marine, and what being a veteran means to me.
I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio.
Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our “leaders” in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind.
**_Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream._**
When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn’t know what I was getting into.
But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life.

[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/jP4g6F9K9gAWM-FTPiaSVg~~/AARclAA~/RgRoo18cP0RwaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS90cnVtcC1uYXRpb25hbC1jb21taXR0ZWUtamZjL2xwLXByc3AtZW1haWwtd2Fsei1taWxpdGFyeS12amQtcG9wLz91dG1fdGM9QUZSMi0yMDI0MDgxN1cDc3BjQgpmu-7FwGZ7y2n-UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)

I deployed to Iraq, did my duty, and I’m proud of my service. But I was lucky. There were some scary moments, but it wasn’t like you’d see in the movies.
My time in the Corps was nothing compared to the sacrifices made by generations of Marines that came before me - and a lot in my own generation.
We ask so much of our men and women deployed around the globe. And they do it with honor and humility.
**_That’s what keeps me going every single day. Our veterans and servicemen, young and old, need to know we have their backs._**

body:
https://www.tamiewilson.com/ [https://www.tamiewilson.com/]
Friends,
Momentum.
That’s what this campaign is all about these days.
In just the first half of August, we’ve raised more than DOUBLE what we raised in all of July, and just last week, we crossed the $1 million raised mark.
People in Ohio and across the country are waking up and realizing that Ohio is back in play, and we’ve got a real shot at sending Jim Jordan home for good.
We’ve closed the gap on Jim Jordan but we need your help to pull far ahead. We’re trying to raise $100,000 before the end of the month. Can you contribute now to help us reach our goal? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240817_momentum_link1]
Why are people rejecting Jim Jordan? Oh, Let me count the ways.
First off, he’s been nothing but an enabler of abuse, turning a blind eye to the suffering of those he was supposed to protect at Ohio State.
We can’t have that kind of moral failure representing us.
Then there’s his disdain for the working families of Ohio—voting against bills like the Farm Bill and CHIPS Act that would bring jobs and investment to our district.
Instead, he focuses on grandstanding on TV while leaving our communities to struggle.
Let’s not forget his relentless attacks on women and women’s rights, trying to drag us back to a time when we had no say over our own bodies.
We need a representative who fights daily to make life easier for all of us, including working families - not going on conspiracy theory-filled rants in judiciary hearings.
But here’s the thing—Ohioans are smart and see through Jim Jordan’s charade. They know that while he’s busy playing ULTRA-MAGA political theater, real people are suffering.
Families are struggling to make ends meet, women are fighting for their basic rights, and our state is missing out on the opportunities it deserves because Jordan is too focused on his own twisted agenda. Every day on the campaign trail I listen to people who are having to choose between buying food or medicine. Jim Jordan has NEVER lifted a finger for them in his 17 years in Congress.
We deserve a leader who’s in the trenches with us, fighting for better jobs, better schools, and better lives.
That’s the kind of leader I am, and that’s the kind of leader I’ll be in Congress. I’ve spent my life working hard for my community, and I’m ready to take that fight to Washington.
But I can’t do it alone.
We’ve got the momentum, we’ve got the people, and now we just need the resources to finish the job.
Let’s make sure we have what it takes to send Jim Jordan packing. Contribute today, help us meet our monthly goal of $100,000, and let’s show everyone what Ohio can do when we stand together! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240817_momentum_link2]

Tamie Wilson

Hello,
The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous _Dobbs_ decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father.
For decades, Dad was an OB-GYN. He delivered thousands of babies and wrote books on how to get pregnant and to navigate menopause. Dad provided women with full access to all kinds of reproductive health care, including abortions, in the years right after _Roe_ – and he has now had to watch as women’s reproductive rights are gutted in the aftermath of _Dobbs_.
Dad and his clinic faced many threats over the years. It’s no exaggeration to say that he put his own safety – and that of his family – at risk in order to protect the rights of women to make their own medical decisions.
But I’m not sure he ever expected to see a sitting member of Congress attacking him – or my sister who followed in his footsteps – in a national news outlet. **It’s disgusting. These kinds of personal attacks against my family have no place in our politics and do nothing to serve the people of Western and Southern Colorado.**
If extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponent want to have a conversation about reproductive rights in this country, I am more than happy to have that debate. We can talk about how I support _freedom_ and _liberty_ – and how they support big government intruding into the lives of women. We can talk about how they support a national ban on abortion – with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother. And we can talk about how they are so extreme, they even want to ban the pill that’s been used by women for decades.
I am willing to talk all day about the fringe view that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions. **But what I won’t accept is extremists like Lauren Boebert and Fox News attacking my father and my sister.**
I am _incredibly_ proud of my father. He provided health care to women when they needed it during some of the happiest – and most devastating – moments of their lives. Before retirement, he would drive two hours to Planned Parenthood and help teach the next generation of health care providers, like my sister. subject: Why the Left doesn’t run as many primary challenger campaigns…
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
One reason why the Left doesn’t run primary challenger campaigns as often as Republicans is because conservative primary challenges have billionaires behind them — and progressive primary challengers do not.
Alexandria started Courage to Change, her leadership PAC to support people-first progressive candidates who fight tooth and nail for social, racial, economic, and environmental justice.
_Moving politics in the direction of the working class requires the working class._
This November, there are hundreds of elections taking place—up and down the ballot. The Left must win as many of them as possible in order to stop fascism from re-entering the White House and to expand our strength in Congress.
**We can and we must do both.**
As we look to November, we need the resources to support our fellow progressives who are facing off against Republican opponents who want to drag our country backwards.

body:
Time to take back what's ours.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91011135/492413553/1328794144?refcode=ea.00702ada-b35c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ms=ea.00702ada-b35c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjAwNzAyYWRhLWIzNWMtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=q7ELm0_i5aPeE9gWM1WqIbe6GFZi3TxJ9NLgp1InDlU=&emci=762718b0-325b-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=00702ada-b35c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=4823105)
---
_If you’ve been wondering how far-right forces gained the power to roll back our rights, imperil our climate, and advance their agenda of radicalism, here’s how:_ Republicans have been playing a long game while Democrats were busy focusing all of their attention on the top of the ticket. Their sneaky strategy? Flip state legislatures while we weren’t looking. And now, Republican controlled-states are wreaking havoc across the nation. **[Much of the real power to shape critical environmental protections and climate regulations lies in statehouses, and with so much at stake this November, we can't let the GOP win. Chip in today to help us elect state-level climate champions.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91011136/492413554/2105508926?refcode=ea.00702ada-b35c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ms=ea.00702ada-b35c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjAwNzAyYWRhLWIzNWMtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=q7ELm0_i5aPeE9gWM1WqIbe6GFZi3TxJ9NLgp1InDlU=)** Republicans netted nearly **1,000 state legislative seats and governors offices** during Barack Obama’s presidency, and by the time the Democratic Party woke up to what was happening, it was too late. State legislative races are constantly overlooked and underfunded, but they hold _real power_ — power over health care and tax policy, gun regulations, reproductive freedom, and even vital climate laws. But here's the kicker — **the vast majority (70%) of voters can’t even name a single thing that their state legislators accomplished in their district. And Republican elected officials were counting on that ignorance to sneak their agenda through while nobody was paying attention.** In GOP-controlled states like Arizona, Texas, and Florida, they’ve passed outrageous anti-climate laws — banning public funds to combat the climate crisis, deleting any mention of climate change from state law, and even eliminating tax incentives for renewable energy companies and expanding fossil-fuel-fired power plants. The GOP didn’t stop there; they’ve been packing the courts with conservative judges for years. These state courts have dismantled rights and protections at lightning speed — from stripping reproductive rights _(remember: the case that overturned Roe started as a challenge to a Mississippi state law)_ to rolling back LGBTQ+ freedoms and making it harder for people to vote. **So, what’s JanePAC doing about it? We’re fighting back.**
* In **California** , we’re going after oily politicians and incumbents who are too cozy with fossil fuel interests. Our strategy is already paying off — we scored big wins in the primary, putting climate champions on the ballot this November.

* In **Arizona** , we’ve endorsed 11 candidates with a historic chance to flip the state legislature with a pro-climate majority. The stakes couldn’t be higher — Arizona is already feeling the brunt of the climate crisis, and these races could decide the state’s future.

* And then there’s **Michigan** , where razor-thin majorities in both chambers make every race a nail-biter. We’ve endorsed climate champions who are ready to defend and expand Michigan’s progress on clean energy and environmental justice.

* But that’s not all. We’ve also endorsed climate champions in **Pennsylvania** , **Colorado** , and **Texas** — key states where the fight for our climate future is unfolding right now. And we’re just getting started.

**[It’s going to take all of us, together, to keep this momentum going and stop the GOP’s reckless agenda at the state level. clean_body: Time to take back what's ours. | If you’ve been wondering how far-right forces gained the power to roll back our rights, imperil our climate, and advance their agenda of radicalism, here’s how: Republicans have been playing a long game while Democrats were busy focusing all of their attention on the top of the ticket. Their sneaky strategy? Flip state legislatures while we weren’t looking. And now, Republican controlled-states are wreaking havoc across the nation. = Republicans netted nearly 1,000 state legislative seats and governors offices during Barack Obama’s presidency, and by the time the Democratic Party woke up to what was happening, it was too late. State legislative races are constantly overlooked and underfunded, but they hold real power — power over health care and tax policy, gun regulations, reproductive freedom, and even vital climate laws. But here's the kicker — the vast majority (70%) of voters can’t even name a single thing that their state legislators accomplished in their district. And Republican elected officials were counting on that ignorance to sneak their agenda through while nobody was paying attention. In GOP-controlled states like Arizona, Texas, and Florida, they’ve passed outrageous anti-climate laws — banning public funds to combat the climate crisis, deleting any mention of climate change from state law, and even eliminating tax incentives for renewable energy companies and expanding fossil-fuel-fired power plants. The GOP didn’t stop there; they’ve been packing the courts with conservative judges for years. These state courts have dismantled rights and protections at lightning speed — from stripping reproductive rights (remember: the case that overturned Roe started as a challenge to a Mississippi state law) to rolling back LGBTQ+ freedoms and making it harder for people to vote. So, what’s JanePAC doing about it? We’re fighting back. In California , we’re going after oily politicians and incumbents who are too cozy with fossil fuel interests. Our strategy is already paying off — we scored big wins in the primary, putting climate champions on the ballot this November. In Arizona , we’ve endorsed 11 candidates with a historic chance to flip the state legislature with a pro-climate majority. The stakes couldn’t be higher — Arizona is already feeling the brunt of the climate crisis, and these races could decide the state’s future. And then there’s Michigan , where razor-thin majorities in both chambers make every race a nail-biter. We’ve endorsed climate champions who are ready to defend and expand Michigan’s progress on clean energy and environmental justice. But that’s not all. We’ve also endorsed climate champions in Pennsylvania , Colorado , and Texas — key states where the fight for our climate future is unfolding right now. body:
[1]Lucas Kunce for U.S. Senate

Peter — I’m a born-and-raised
Missourian.

And if Josh Hawley had his way, my kids would not be alive today.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/67046?refcode=em20240817-7364&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=7364%2E614464%2ESW8r-E ]Photo of Andy with his kids.

I know that might sound dramatic, and this is a long email. But if you
give me just a couple minutes of your time to explain, I know you’ll agree
— [ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/67046?refcode=em20240817-7364&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=7364%2E614464%2ESW8r-E ]and I hope you’ll then chip in to help Lucas Kunce defeat Josh Hawley
this November.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/67046?refcode=em20240817-7364&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=7364%2E614464%2ESW8r-E ]CHIP IN NOW

It might be easy to assume I’m talking about Hawley’s continued opposition
to marriage equality. He even voted against it in 2022. While Josh Hawley
does seem to care a lot about what happens in my bedroom, I’m actually not
married — just gay.

While it’s safe to assume Hawley’s opposition to civil rights protections
for gay Americans means he doesn’t want me to be a parent anyway, his
assault on my right to build and raise a family has a lot more to do with
reproductive freedom — something that matters to each and every one of you
reading this.

Like many Americans — women, men, gay, straight — I had to rely on IVF to
build my family. I’m so incredibly thankful for the doctors, donors, and
rockstar surrogates who helped bring my kids into the world. Those women
gave me life. They gave me the chance to have a family. And I will be
forever indebted to them.

My son Ben was born in 2019, and my daughter Lucy was born in 2022 — just
a few months before the Dobbs decision. As any parent with IVF kids can
tell you, it isn’t easy. It’s expensive, takes time, and often fails.
Fertilized embryos will almost inevitably be lost, and the costs
associated with indefinite storage means extra embryos are almost always
either donated to research, donated to family, or discarded. It’s an
immense privilege to be able to build a family with IVF, when it should be
a right.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/67046?refcode=em20240817-7364&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=7364%2E614464%2ESW8r-E ]St. Louis Public Radio headline: 'No protection for IVF' Missouri
advocates sound alarm after IVF safeguards stymied in legislature.

Now, two years after Dobbs, we’re living in an America that has less
freedom than it did before — from a total abortion ban in Missouri and IVF
shutdowns in Alabama, to “fetal personhood” laws (which Missouri also has)
that threaten reproductive freedom in its entirety.

And no U.S. Senator is more personally responsible for it than Josh Hawley
— who is now up for his first election since everything changed.

You might already know about Josh Hawley’s extreme anti-choice views and
how he’s used his taxpayer-funded office to support his wife's legal work
in the Dobbs case and in the case to ban the abortion pill nationwide —
[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/67046?refcode=em20240817-7364&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1005&akid=7364%2E614464%2ESW8r-E ]and if that’s reason enough for you to want to help Lucas Kunce defeat
Hawley in November, then add a donation to help Lucas get it done.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/67046?refcode=em20240817-7364&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1006&akid=7364%2E614464%2ESW8r-E ]CHIP IN NOW

But if you didn’t already know about Josh Hawley’s deep personal
involvement in every single part of the nationwide assault on reproductive
freedom, then keep reading.

It all started when Hawley led the Hobby Lobby case in front of the
Supreme Court, which gave employers the power to refuse coverage for birth
control for their workers. He even said contraceptives “may induce an
abortion by preventing implantation of a fertilized egg” — which, to be
clear, is not true or what an abortion is according to virtually every
medical professional.

Once Hawley got to the U.S. Senate, he did everything he could to push his
extreme anti-reproductive freedom agenda forward: Putting campaign donors
as well as anti-IVF and anti-surrogacy extremists on our courts. Using his
taxpayer-funded office to support his activist-lawyer wife's cases to
overturn Roe, enacting Missouri’s total abortion ban, and even trying to
ban the abortion pill nationwide. And sponsoring extreme “fetal
personhood” bills at the national level.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/67046?refcode=em20240817-7364&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1007&akid=7364%2E614464%2ESW8r-E ]On the left, a headline from The Guardian: Hawley's anti-abortion
arguments echoed in AL IVF case. On the right, a headline from the
Washington Post: Nominee who is anti-IVF and surrogacy was deemed
unqualified. Hawley: 'I was proud to recommend her.'

Then, last month, Hawley made it clearer than ever how he feels about IVF
and our right to build a family: He voted against a bill to guarantee
access to IVF and make it more affordable. His reason?

Hawley told the media the Right To IVF Act was really part of an “abortion
agenda.”

I’m sorry, but that’s CRAZY.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/67046?refcode=em20240817-7364&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1008&akid=7364%2E614464%2ESW8r-E ]CHIP IN TO FIGHT BACK

His ultimate goal here is obvious — Josh Hawley doesn’t just want Big
Brother politicians like himself to control us in our bedrooms and our
doctor’s offices. He wants to control OUR bodies, and even how we choose
to build and raise OUR families.

And if he gets another six years to finish what he’s started, then the
ability to build a family like mine — or even likely a family like yours —
could be made impossible.

Josh Hawley poses a unique and existential threat to reproductive freedom,
and this is our one chance to put a stop to his crusade against our
freedoms. [ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/67046?refcode=em20240817-7364&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1009&akid=7364%2E614464%2ESW8r-E ]We can’t afford to give him another six years in the U.S.
Senate — so, I'm asking: Can you please add a donation to Lucas Kunce’s
campaign today so we can secure our freedoms?

If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your
contribution instantly:

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/67047?refcode=em20240817-7364&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=1010&akid=7364%2E614464%2ESW8r-E ]Contribute $10
