I warned you already this was a long email, so you can’t blame me for
wanting to tell you a bit more about Lucas Kunce and why I know he can
defeat Josh Hawley — but only if he has your help. Lucas is the Marine
veteran and born-and-raised Missourian taking Hawley on this November.
He’s built a record-breaking movement and is drawing huge crowds at events
across the state.

And he’s even sharing the ballot this November with a referendum to end
the Hawley-backed abortion ban in Missouri, which will be a huge boost for
Democratic turnout just as it has been in red and purple states across the
country in recent elections.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/67046?refcode=em20240817-7364&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1017&akid=7364%2E614464%2ESW8r-E ]New York Times headline: Abortion Rights Fuel Big Democratic Wins, and
Hopes for 2024

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/67046?refcode=em20240817-7364&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1018&akid=7364%2E614464%2ESW8r-E ]CHIP IN TO ELECT LUCAS

Not long ago, Missourians came together to defeat Todd Akin after his
extreme views on abortion came to light, but that didn’t happen overnight.

Akin exposed himself in August of that election year, and a poll that same
month showed him with an 11% lead. It took weeks and MONTHS of hard work,
advertising, and organizing to expose Akin’s extremism to Missouri voters
— and because we all came together, Missourians rejected Akin on Election
Day by a 15% margin (a total change of 26% from August).

And while you might be surprised to hear about Democrats doing that well
in a red state, that kind of result isn’t rare in Missouri.

In our last U.S. Senate race that took place in a presidential election,
Jason Kander outperformed the presidential ticket by 16%, nearly defeating
incumbent Roy Blunt, who had the entire GOP establishment behind him. In
fact, the race against Blunt got close with almost identical timing to the
race against Akin — Kander was polling by as much as 14% behind Blunt, but
after pushing hard on ads and organizing starting in the fall, the race
was neck-and-neck.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/67046?refcode=em20240817-7364&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1019&akid=7364%2E614464%2ESW8r-E ]On top, a Spectrum News headline: Recent poll found Hawley was the
least popular GOP senator up for reelection among voters. In the middle,
AP headline: Missouri abortion-rights campaign turns in more than double
the needed signatures to get on the ballot. On the bottom, a quote from
Jason Kander in the KC Star: 'Lucas Kunce can defeat Josh Hawley. Anyone
who cares about democracy, reproductive freedom, and working families,
this race should be a priority.'

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/67046?refcode=em20240817-7364&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=7364%2E614464%2ESW8r-E ]CHIP IN TO BEAT HAWLEY

Now I’m going to say something you may not want to hear, but it is true
and important for this race: Josh Hawley is more extreme than Donald Trump
and almost every Republican on reproductive freedom. In fact, he
objectively has the worst record on reproductive rights of any U.S.
Senator. That means we don’t have to wait for Hawley to have a “Todd Akin
moment” — his entire six years in the Senate has been one.

But it’s an election year, which means Josh Hawley will be telling all
sorts of lies to voters claiming he’s not responsible for this assault on
our freedoms. And that’s where you and me come in.

We need to help Lucas expose Hawley’s anti-freedom crusade to Missouri
voters on TV, online, at their doors, and in their mailboxes, and that
takes resources. [ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/67046?refcode=em20240817-7364&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=7364%2E614464%2ESW8r-E ]So if it wasn’t clear already, your support could
make all the difference in this race — will you join me in helping Lucas

Here’s the situation:
For the last _40 years_ , expert federal agencies have had the power to implement critical, life-saving regulations.
Everything, from food safety regulations to environmental protections, was possible because these federal agencies were able to utilize their expertise to issue regulations. The system worked because of a judicial doctrine called **Chevron deference** , and we can credit a lot of the progress we’ve made to it.
Then, just a few weeks ago, our corrupt Supreme Court ruled to overturn this precedent, saying that _if**any** part of a law is left open to interpretation, federal agencies no longer have the final authority to decide what it means._
So if the EPA tries to rein in pollution through a provision under the Clean Air Act, **a corporation can sue to get the rule knocked off — and corrupt judges can overrule agency experts and side with that corporation.**
Yeah. It’s bad.

Before I ran for office, I worked for Planned Parenthood, traveling all over the country to raise funds to protect health care access for millions of Americans.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91013781/492422579/1951025404?amount=10&refcode=RS_EM_FR_2024.08.17_PPLongform_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YjRhNmQwNC1iYTVjLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=P-6RgEugF0J8ba2XPUDgtQ4aH2yw3ns8spw2-oo7kCA=) Peter — **Planned Parenthood Action Fund endorsed our campaign for Congress — and I wanted to share why this is especially meaningful for me.** Before I ran for office, I worked for Planned Parenthood, traveling all over the country to raise funds to protect health care access for millions of Americans. Every day, far from the spotlight, the professionals at Planned Parenthood improve, transform, and save lives. I can confidently say that working for them changed my life. I saw that in so many areas of this country, Planned Parenthood clinics are one of the only sources of affordable health care — and not just abortion care. They are a critical lifeline to poor people, queer and trans folks, communities of color, and those living in isolated rural communities. I met women, men, and people of all genders whose lives were tangibly changed because they could receive care at Planned Parenthood. They got screenings that caught cancer early enough to treat. They got reliable information about prenatal care, postpartum depression, STIs, and birth control they couldn’t find elsewhere. And, yes, they made informed decisions about their pregnancies, their bodies, and their futures without interference from any judge, protestor, or politician. I also saw the unnecessary and cruel barriers to care in Republican-controlled states. In states that didn’t expand Medicaid, the need for affordable care at clinics was (and still is) overwhelming. While not lifting a finger to improve healthcare access, right-wing politicians used Planned Parenthood clinics and their staffs as scapegoats and political punching bags. Before the _Dobbs_ decision, when they couldn’t ban abortion outright, they piled regulation after regulation on clinics that made operating nearly impossible, forcing many to close. When Trump was elected, I couldn’t stop thinking about the real, terrifying impact that he would have — on _Roe v. Wade_ , on women’s rights and LGBTQ+ freedom, and on the people I’d met around the country seeking safe, affordable, lifesaving care. **On the same night that they called the 2016 election for Trump, I decided to run for office in Washington state. Because of supporters like you, I went to Olympia as part of a pro-choice majority in both the House and Senate:** • We’ve made birth control more available and accessible. • We stockpiled mifepristone to ensure Washington residents have access to the safest and most effective medication abortion protocol. • We required all insurance plans that cover maternity care to also cover abortion and ensured that trans folks have equal access to comprehensive reproductive healthcare. • We removed financial barriers by ending abortion cost-sharing. • We enacted meaningful data privacy and shield legislation — to protect trans folks seeking gender-affirming care in Washington state and individuals seeking abortion here from persecution or prosecution in their home states. We’ve been leaders in _this Washington_ – and I’ll continue this work in Congress, where I’ll do everything in my power to protect our reproductive freedom in places like Washington state and restore it wherever we can. clean_body: Before I ran for office, I worked for Planned Parenthood, traveling all over the country to raise funds to protect health care access for millions of Americans. | = Peter — Planned Parenthood Action Fund endorsed our campaign for Congress — and I wanted to share why this is especially meaningful for me. Before I ran for office, I worked for Planned Parenthood, traveling all over the country to raise funds to protect health care access for millions of Americans. Every day, far from the spotlight, the professionals at Planned Parenthood improve, transform, and save lives. I can confidently say that working for them changed my life. I saw that in so many areas of this country, Planned Parenthood clinics are one of the only sources of affordable health care — and not just abortion care. They are a critical lifeline to poor people, queer and trans folks, communities of color, and those living in isolated rural communities. I met women, men, and people of all genders whose lives were tangibly changed because they could receive care at Planned Parenthood. They got screenings that caught cancer early enough to treat. They got reliable information about prenatal care, postpartum depression, STIs, and birth control they couldn’t find elsewhere. And, yes, they made informed decisions about their pregnancies, their bodies, and their futures without interference from any judge, protestor, or politician. I also saw the unnecessary and cruel barriers to care in Republican-controlled states. In states that didn’t expand Medicaid, the need for affordable care at clinics was (and still is) overwhelming. While not lifting a finger to improve healthcare access, right-wing politicians used Planned Parenthood clinics and their staffs as scapegoats and political punching bags. Before the Dobbs decision, when they couldn’t ban abortion outright, they piled regulation after regulation on clinics that made operating nearly impossible, forcing many to close. When Trump was elected, I couldn’t stop thinking about the real, terrifying impact that he would have — on Roe v. Wade , on women’s rights and LGBTQ+ freedom, and on the people I’d met around the country seeking safe, affordable, lifesaving care. On the same night that they called the 2016 election for Trump, I decided to run for office in Washington state. Now, Republicans are THREATENING clean energy advancements. August 17, 2024
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
CONTACT: Houston Keene
press@nancyforalaska.com

ICYMI: Nancy Dahlstrom Attended Ketchikan Blueberry Arts Festival

ANCHORAGE, AK - In case you missed it
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=71271&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=64532> , Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom attended
the Ketchikan Blueberry Arts Festival, sharing her message of security
and prosperity with Alaskans.

Dahlstrom, who was endorsed by President Donald J. Trump, visited
Ketchikan amid her race to unseat Democrat Mary Peltola and return
Alaskan conservative leadership and values back to Congress.

Check out some of the coverage
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=71271&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=64532> from Ketchikan Daily News:

"Dahlstrom, who is from Eagle River, visited with Ketchikan residents
on one of the warmest days of the year, acknowledging, however, that as
a result of being in Juneau - first as the commissioner of the Alaska
Department of Corrections and now as the lieutenant governor - she has
experienced Southeast Alaska.

'I like it here,' Dahlstrom said. 'I will be back here, and my ...
goal, should I be one of the three (Alaska congressional members) in
Washington, D.C., would be to bring as many people as I can from other
states here.

'Because what I know is that when they see how different Alaska is,
first of all they love and respect the beauty' and they see the
vastness of Alaska and can better understand issues related to its
natural resources."

"' ... I absolutely support unleashing all of Alaska's resources,'
Dahlstrom said. 'We know how to drill (for oil) safely onshore (and)
offshore; we know how to mine; we know how to, we've been doing it all
these years.'"

You can read the full article from the Ketchikan Daily News by clicking
here
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=71271&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=64532> .

Peter,

Tammy Baldwin is in full panic mode. We blindsided her in this race, by making the election for Wisconsin’s battleground Senate seat a statistical dead heat.

Politics and culture never cease to fascinate me, but I often find myself frustrated by trying to explain what seems so obvious, yet bizarrely invisible to so many professional writers. For decades, I have been fascinated by an unfolding history that few seem either able--or even inclined--to understand.
My disdain for whatever passes for journalism in the U.S. tends to keep my fire lit for writing prose reflecting on current events. When my patience fades and nihilism threatens to rise in its place, however, I find myself drawn to other modes of expression.
A road trip up the California coast a few years ago led me to the Redwood National and State Parks. The trip, and a hike along the beach, offered a series of images and prompted a short poem that I was grateful to stumble across this week. I hope it offers you something useful.

### **Which? (3/19/17)**
Are we all
bugs
trapped
in a urinal?
wet wings
frozen to ceramic
our legs
frantically
flailing
our very
existence
depending
on righting
ourselves
and yet
we cannot?
Or are we
tiny
plants
growing
out of even
smaller
spaces
rotting
out of
driftwood
washed up
on the beach?
Or are we
giant
trees
anchored
in precarious
hillsides
resisting
by existing
our roots
holding
together
the Earth?
_Paid subscribers can access another poem written two years before this one. It 's a [pantoum](https://substack.com/redirect/a29ede0b-2481-47c5-9c15-bcce78c4f469?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) reflecting not only a different form and style from the one above, but also a decidedly different view of human existence--and the choices before each of us as we pass through this life..._

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**“New Mexico is my home. I was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of my childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas Blvd. and Monroe St. with my seven brothers, sisters, and parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. I began my education at Our Lady of Fatima, where I learned the values I hold today. I am the devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. My family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and it is here that I have always returned, no matter where my life has taken me. My husband Pat and I cherish our home in New Mexico, that we have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like my father and mother, I have been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those whom quality healthcare was out of reach. I have also been a champion of improving the education of our youth in underserved communities.

Like everyone starting their career, I began at the bottom and worked my way up through the complex finance world, where I eventually served as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In my career, I helped build businesses, helped companies grow, and created jobs. With this business experience, I will help New Mexico attract new companies and create jobs - so hardworking New Mexicans can find success and live their American Dream.

New Mexico is blessed with abundant natural resources, cultural diversity and rich traditions, hardworking people, and leading national laboratories. But sadly, our leaders in Washington and Santa Fe have failed us. The cost of living is up, we are in a crime crisis, the border is wide open, and our public education system is leaving our kids behind.

We are clearly on the wrong track. We can and must do better. That’s why I am running for the United States Senate.” _-Nella_**

I’m sick and tired of their antics — so I’m doing everything in my power to SAVE the White House and ensure we appoint more amazing Supreme Court Justices like YOU.

body:
Trump throws tantrums, slurs words, and just acts weird, and yet the outrage level is nowhere near it was for President Biden’s bad debate.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91018816/492440106/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZmE0NjA5YjEtYzI1Yy1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=GrhDXcPasKAHvroG9pbK_fXW86plLWRC-zOdK-a8jHs=&emci=3c7823a9-c25c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=fa4609b1-c25c-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
There’s no denying it – **Kamala Harris has created an incredible amount of excitement and energy since becoming the Democratic nominee.** Since Biden passed the torch, Trump’s campaign has cratered, and the deeper that hole gets, the more Trump himself looks unwell and unhinged.
Just this week, Trump has:
* **Claimed that Harris’ (much larger) rally crowds were AI-generated and fake.**
* **Bombed a glitchy _X_ /Twitter livestream with Elon Musk where Trump slurred his speech, lied constantly, and generally was incoherent.**
* **Held a much-hyped North Carolina “speech” on the economy that a _USA Today_ opinion columnist described as, “a dumb speech on a bunch of stuff that has nothing to do with the economy.”**

Remember when the legacy media put a 24/7 pressure campaign on President Biden to drop out of the race because of a poor debate performance? So, we ask for the one billionth time, **where is the similar outrage for Trump’s erratic, off-the-wall behavior?**
[**We’ll talk more about the media’s hypocrisy in a second, but if you want to help COURIER hold the mainstream media accountable for their coverage, can you chip in $20?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91018817/492440109/-593472309?refcode=20240817-EM-TrumpHypocrisy&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZmE0NjA5YjEtYzI1Yy1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=GrhDXcPasKAHvroG9pbK_fXW86plLWRC-zOdK-a8jHs=)
So, where is the media outrage about Trump? Where is the concern about a mentally unwell man becoming President again?
Following President Biden’s poor debate performance, legacy media like **_The New York Times_** and **_The Washington Post_** ran editorials calling on Biden to drop out, citing concerns about his age and mental fitness. Coverage on cable news channels was never-ending, especially on **_CNN_** , **_MSNBC_** , and **_Fox News_**.
Once Biden finally passed the torch to Harris, right-wing outlets like **_Fox News_** even said Biden hadn’t done enough, calling on him to resign the presidency.
The media were tough on Biden, but, as always, they continue to hypocritically treat Trump with kid gloves. They keep airing his rambling press conferences and speeches, and to anyone watching, it’s obvious that Trump’s decline is becoming more public and pronounced as Harris picks up momentum.

Peter, There’s no denying it – Kamala Harris has created an incredible amount of excitement and energy since becoming the Democratic nominee. Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=081724_1&amount=25]
CBS: Eligible voters are being swept up in conservative activists' efforts to purge voter rolls [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=081724_1&amount=25]
Team: Up to 500,000 Georgians were at risk of having their voter registration “purged” before Election Day. Untold numbers were removed.
Partisan election officials conduct mass registered voter removals, as required by recent Georgia voter suppression laws -- laws that include limits on mail-in ballots, the criminalization of giving out water to voters waiting in line, and so much more.
T hese purges disenfranchise legitimate registered voters who haven’t moved or had other changes to their status as voters . Multiple stories written by the Atlanta Journal-Constitution in recent years have highlighted wrongfully purged voters and show the evidence clearly.
This comes after groups based outside of Georgia brought massed challenges against almost 400,000 Georgia voters in the 2022 general election and runoff. That doesn't include the 92,000 additional challenges brought in Georgia by amateur " voter fraud hunters " who believe the lies peddled by partisan activists trying to shake our faith in our elections and guarantee their party wins elections.
Voter suppression is real, Team, both in Georgia and across the country. Push back on these cynical purges and voter challenges with $25 or whatever you can today to protect the right to vote nationwide >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=081724_1&amount=25]

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-aug24.RD8FO-&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240817_PM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=3347%2E35263%2E77_5u4 ]Tammy Baldwin

I’m used to being written off,
Peter.

When I first ran for Congress in Wisconsin in 1997, no one thought I could
win — especially when an extremely popular challenger jumped into the
race.

I remember huddling with one of my staffers at the time, and she said,
“Well Tammy, maybe you want to rethink what you’re doing because it’s
going to be tough.”

I looked her right in the eye and asked, “Do you think I should wait my
turn?”

The next thing I said was this: I believe that women have to run —
especially when it’s hard — and not wait our turn. We can’t wait until we
get a tap on our shoulder or we’ll never get anywhere.

I ended up winning that race and became the very first woman elected to
the House of Representatives from Wisconsin. And it wouldn’t be the last
time our team would make history.

When I ran for U.S. Senate in 2012, an incredible team of grassroots
supporters like you fought alongside me — even as some people wrote us
off. You helped me become the first woman elected to the chamber from our
state and the first openly gay Senator in our nation’s history.

In 2018, despite being a top target for national Republicans and enduring
over a year of attacks, you stood with me again, and we won.

Time and again, grassroots supporters like you have helped us defy the
odds. The battle to protect my seat this year will be no different, with
this race being my toughest election yet.

Eric Hovde and his Republican allies have already spent more than $26
million to buy this seat and recent polls are showing this race in a dead
heat. Protecting this seat won’t be easy, but together, I know we can defy
the odds once again.

subject: Keep AZ blue
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY YASSAMIN ANSARI FOR CONGRESS
body:
Our state is the key to the White House, the Senate, and the House this November,

| |
---
Peter, **This November, there will be critical races up and down the ballot here in Arizona.** It's not a coincidence that our state was the epicenter of Donald Trump's stolen election lies. It's one of the most important battlegrounds in the nation, and it could decide control of the presidency and both houses of Congress. The work necessary to win those races happens right here, Peter. Everything you read here is true. Every dollar we raise will go back into winning in Arizona. Every deadline and every goal is real (including daily deadlines, because we’re working out the campaign’s cash flow on a weekly basis now).

Everything you read here is true. Every dollar we raise will go back into winning in Arizona. Every deadline and every goal is real (including daily deadlines, because we’re working out the campaign’s cash flow on a weekly basis now). Those goals aren’t arbitrary. They’re what we need to raise if we’re going to compete with the millions of dollars of outside spending that is flowing into Arizona right now. They’re trying to defeat us with a tidal wave of attack ads — and we don’t intend to let them. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91021965/492452008/-1463099547?refcode=-header-&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODMyNmE0ZWItY2E1Yy1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=mXPxsb8Yh1RrD8K4Ux78gbPFJXTS2mgYprCwL8b-Pno=) | Peter, You’ve probably heard about Donald Trump’s nasty, racist comments on Kamala. At an event hosted by the National Association of Black Journalists (you can’t make up the irony), Donald Trump said: _**"I didn't know she was Black until a number of years ago when she happened to turn Black, and now she wants to be known as Black."**_ Thankfully there has been some good coverage in the mainstream media about why this attack is racist and unacceptable. I agree wholeheartedly. **I want to write to you about why this is happening and what we’re going to do about it.** This cycle, we have the luxury of understanding Trump and his playbook. It’s not rocket science. When he’s feeling good, he lies. When he’s feeling lousy, he lies and becomes unhinged. The past few weeks have been pretty terrible for his campaign. Kamala has energized Democrats to record levels and is straight up beating him at the things he cares about (crowd sizes). So what does he do? He pulls out the racist attacks, not because he thinks they will work to change voters’ minds, but simply because he’s mad and he genuinely believes it. He’s losing his filter. When Trump starts making racist comments, it’s vital we respond with one voice - it is wrong, it is a lie, and then we have to tell the truth. This isn’t about just one throw-away comment; this is about whether we want to let the leader of the country hold racist beliefs. I really think it’s that simple. What kind of country do we want to be? name: Sen. Jacky Rosen
subject: Three values I've carried my whole life
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rosen for Nevada
body:
| | |
---
Friend: When I was growing up, I never could have imagined that I'd run for elected office one day – let alone become the first computer programmer and the first former synagogue president ever elected to the Senate.
As the granddaughter of Jewish immigrants and the daughter of a World War II veteran, I was surrounded by loved ones who taught me the values of hard work, determination, and persistence – and I've carried these with me my entire life.

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: The return of Betsy DeVos
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| Friend,

If you were waiting for the perfect time to make one more donation to my campaign for Senate, not only is today the perfect day but there's also a very good reason as well.

Betsy DeVos.

If you're already familiar with her significant support for my opponent and are ready to chip in to my campaign and the Voter Protection Project, [_please use this link to give »_](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/75014?t=6&akid=16134%2E878179%2EPOqVLU)

Otherwise, let me go a little deeper... including a very recent revelation about her designs on a role in a second Trump administration.

As Michiganders know, for decades the DeVos family’s #1 issue has been weakening Michigan's, and the country's, public education system. Betsy DeVos used Michigan as her petri dish before becoming Trump’s Secretary of Education, and one of his longest serving cabinet secretaries.

Much like our Republican opponent, Mike Rogers, she condemned Donald Trump after January 6, 2021. In Betsy DeVos’ case, she “resigned in protest” as Education Secretary, blaming his rhetoric on the insurrection — just 13 days before the end of Trump’s term.

And like my current opponent who turned around and worked hard for Trump's endorsement, Betsy DeVos is now back — and willing to serve in a second Trump administration. [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/75014?t=7&akid=16134%2E878179%2EPOqVLU) So what does that mean?

As if there weren't already a million reasons to defeat Donald Trump, there's now one more: keeping Betsy DeVos out of any role of prominence in Washington, D.C.

And there is no doing that without winning in Michigan.

The DeVos family has been some of the top supporters to opponents of mine in the past, and they've doubled down on this Senate race.

Mike Rogers' first FEC report in this race was filled with donations from a bunch of members of the DeVos family — contributions totaling $46,200 all made on one single day. And just last week, Betsy DeVos herself was campaigning with Mike Rogers at a roundtable just a day before the primary election.

They are certainly not done with their support of my opponent.

On a positive note, the response to emails about the DeVos donations has raised far more than the DeVos family has contributed. But we have to keep going, because their family's unlimited wealth can impact this race in many more ways.

So in light of this news about Betsy DeVos' potential return to Washington, D.C. and her role in campaigning for my opponent, I am asking:

[_Can you split a contribution of $10 directly to the Voter Protection Project and my campaign for U.S. Senate in Michigan? I will put your donation made today in Betsy’s name right to work persuading the voters we need to win in Michigan this fall._](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/75014?t=8&akid=16134%2E878179%2EPOqVLU) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Elissa Slotkin and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/75015?t=9&akid=16134%2E878179%2EPOqVLU)

Thank you,
Elissa

To keep our communities safe from police violence and create true public safety for all of us, we need policies like the People's Response Act | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.X6XUC7u8ppFLNtMO_55SZlNseb7gEYIOhm_EWnhzEOZKmTtnV3k2h4V2x_O3H7rdW2az5rgktBwzxQ8Ml9Wgkmv85qW-UsBonL4KRa0bcNqdICU6T3NBDdNIZG7w7wEWzUOzUNdQEA5K3octjBN0YkkqDZhnJnl6klKl1V002-4qmwRl20CGlvskIuLkaXN4ijZADNgCvk3E93-ZpGZxWN2TylL69qz54PVdM2Z_1UHnt4aJH1tvwzrkimUtsgx2aoD8IHYHbaq6-UnEWjKuA6Ny8PlkLSlgI-EgUvJIxsZ1KHzFQ1lhjSJFJq4cP-b4S3iHrQ8yK6ar6ePxNWxGh0LjZ2Y_ga3pg2MYeP3j7S0/48z/Azp96axDSTuy-e-M8DwvdQ/h0/h001.Y-5t-QiOo34UGm_sQaKLB6XXrn4hkGqq0zDml7EzVp8)
---
Friend, Last month Sonya Massey called 911 for help during a health emergency. In response to her request for help, a police officer came and killed her in her home. Sonya Massey should still be alive. As the Movement for Black Lives wrote: “Calling for emergency services shouldn’t be a death sentence. But time and time again, police mishandle emergency situations, escalate to violence, and execute Black people.” Clearly, **our system of policing doesn’t keep people safe**. It disproportionately harms Black people, who often avoid calling the police when they are undergoing some of the most difficult emergencies. Sonya knew this, asking police when they arrived to not hurt her. No wonder polls show that 88% of Black Americans support hiring mental health professionals as non-police first responders to de-escalate mental health crises. We urgently need to pass policies like Rep. Cori Bush’s _People's Response Act_ , which would **transform our approach to public safety to center care, not criminalization**. If passed, this groundbreaking legislation would support local governments and community-based organizations in launching and scaling **public health alternatives to policing, including investing in unarmed emergency first responders** such as licensed social workers, mental health counselors, substance use counselors, and peer support specialists. [**To help build a world where Black and marginalized people can call for help and not risk being murdered by police, please add your name in support of the _People's Response Act_ now.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38fpUT9zwDeUV848vbsvJkoDoc0_X-JrXvGQGWIwM3A6u6ZyGf6U53_URSs8tj5IjphwpcOSCQl8uMWC7jMVER-XJdrL7FF7gje0w-V39oXcnadFW2A4AqLM1YTZCdbB63grQVQWviN9LWbwOXUUL0DuMB_SqixvkOuf6HeHsXy7YfXPKe3assTOBbnevq0WAd383LTHMPz2LI1KEmHyoagBkTGSbYlIXsS6nFfrN8qs7XQErXC-_kuNU-KuHgt7QShdmEet3O0cPGijHxPwldGY-XXevaPnV8BepzbC8CCgno18YWYVEzmzp9ZVwWwUEi5vBzN66cdEvL8zvzka20U/48z/Azp96axDSTuy-e-M8DwvdQ/h1/h001.a6vyGjm9XKfqIi4F7yK0JMkm_6HJ4Pgo6gN9jY2phaw) | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38fpUT9zwDeUV848vbsvJkoDoc0_X-JrXvGQGWIwM3A6rcljOTR6weaqJDKSu13YiwEPFJubBJ39wSzCv3GD7JZJmIWGiSrJHBfVCX3mD5jh0Y4gSRI4W_v9LiL71942pcKlBJpHlrlThWhjmqiF18Wk-0VjsSmegiPJoBcY3MKBNpE-lGz3cMTtSy4Qymvmd9lcxioA-I67QGKEG2azpOtfyQoe5xVLztCBVDzxIFXXnxUerUEIqu8HlhukwkyBdtopvlUkYrtn7AKrEingtYq0hQpf5W3j7LyzG5lL5pDzRNupPFDwfSfq_0zoPD_PJwi6OcMGRAb5emqQ6-KpaLg/48z/Azp96axDSTuy-e-M8DwvdQ/h2/h001.sC9vFR6SYBvvqKhUJYvoVeSe3a76pFZBKHFz-TdmaB8)
---
My sister in service Cori Bush protested in the streets of Ferguson for hundreds of days with other community members who were outraged about the brutal police murder of 18-year-old Michael Brown. They sparked the beginning of the movement for Black Lives, which is still demanding policies to prevent police violence and ensure true public safety.
**Like Sonya Massey and others killed by state-sanctioned violence, Michael Brown should still be here today.** Instead we recently marked the tenth anniversary of his tragic murder. Cori Bush wrote: “In his name, we will never stop fighting for justice, accountability, and an end to police brutality.”
During the Ferguson Uprising, Cori was also violently brutalized by police while trying to bring a woman to paramedics to help with a medical emergency. She had previously been a nurse serving people with mental health crises, where she witnessed punitive responses that harmed the vulnerable people in her care.
**As the first activist from the movement for Black lives to be elected to Congress, Cori Bush has led transformational policies to keep our communities safe from police violence and create true public safety for all of us.** She engaged with community groups around the country on the _People's Response Act_.
Cori won’t serve her next term in Congress, since right-wing billionaires targeted her and bought her seat. That’s all the more reason why we must build support now for her much-needed public safety legislation.
[**If you agree that we must urgently transform our system of public safety to center care, not criminalization, please sign on to show your support for the _People’s Response Act_ today.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38fpUT9zwDeUV848vbsvJkoDoc0_X-JrXvGQGWIwM3A6o0gWUOyNU4AotAODvTrTSNV7C5uGrUX6woERTpwDd3w3OMFlpJGEP1eUCpAMQD0tECtz-MmBX39z8RFrjy3m4xW_74_yD07QeWjVd3o34Xcb-jTuI6TItv1i-7jCjTSF7bzedoWZs9tEaxxWDZf7I99vJeAtt88p0kSulqw5M4bQ6a6JU2MGJQF47tPSmzjLfoCmT35NNohFfHg6bbE7xih8smVWrWeBKZDHErMfIzDRAkzbZ358k6-AVF0Iw6IzcktrMVPuaq0MIi4P8c1V0-Wcn1o4f4nn3Gi09yz8Liu/48z/Azp96axDSTuy-e-M8DwvdQ/h3/h001.Yv6-ay60h1eYTF5AOk_cqw8k0kX6nbOhe0vQmQ6nN_U)
Thank you for continuing to push for a world that truly values people’s safety and well-being. I will keep advocating against ever-growing spending on police and military budgets and instead calling for much-needed investments in marginalized communities.
In solidarity,

clean_body: To keep our communities safe from police violence and create true public safety for all of us, we need policies like the People's Response Act | | | Friend, Last month Sonya Massey called 911 for help during a health emergency. In response to her request for help, a police officer came and killed her in her home. Sonya Massey should still be alive. As the Movement for Black Lives wrote: “Calling for emergency services shouldn’t be a death sentence. But time and time again, police mishandle emergency situations, escalate to violence, and execute Black people.” Clearly, our system of policing doesn’t keep people safe. It disproportionately harms Black people, who often avoid calling the police when they are undergoing some of the most difficult emergencies. Sonya knew this, asking police when they arrived to not hurt her. No wonder polls show that 88% of Black Americans support hiring mental health professionals as non-police first responders to de-escalate mental health crises. We urgently need to pass policies like Rep. Cori Bush’s People's Response Act , which would transform our approach to public safety to center care, not criminalization. If passed, this groundbreaking legislation would support local governments and community-based organizations in launching and scaling public health alternatives to policing, including investing in unarmed emergency first responders such as licensed social workers, mental health counselors, substance use counselors, and peer support specialists. | My sister in service Cori Bush protested in the streets of Ferguson for hundreds of days with other community members who were outraged about the brutal police murder of 18-year-old Michael Brown. They sparked the beginning of the movement for Black Lives, which is still demanding policies to prevent police violence and ensure true public safety. Like Sonya Massey and others killed by state-sanctioned violence, Michael Brown should still be here today. Instead we recently marked the tenth anniversary of his tragic murder. Cori Bush wrote: “In his name, we will never stop fighting for justice, accountability, and an end to police brutality.” During the Ferguson Uprising, Cori was also violently brutalized by police while trying to bring a woman to paramedics to help with a medical emergency. She had previously been a nurse serving people with mental health crises, where she witnessed punitive responses that harmed the vulnerable people in her care. As the first activist from the movement for Black lives to be elected to Congress, Cori Bush has led transformational policies to keep our communities safe from police violence and create true public safety for all of us. She engaged with community groups around the country on the People's Response Act. Cori won’t serve her next term in Congress, since right-wing billionaires targeted her and bought her seat. That’s all the more reason why we must build support now for her much-needed public safety legislation. Thank you for continuing to push for a world that truly values people’s safety and well-being. I will keep advocating against ever-growing spending on police and military budgets and instead calling for much-needed investments in marginalized communities. In solidarity, Rashida Rashida Tlaib for Congress PO Box 32777 Detroit, MI 48232 | Paid for by Rashida Tlaib for Congress | | Sent via . subject: Please welcome Professor Butch Ware as my running mate!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vp_rollout&n=1)
---
Peter,

I am honored and thrilled to welcome Professor Butch Ware to the Green Party ticket as my running mate!

**[Will you help me welcome Professor Ware with a generous contribution today?](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vp_rollout&n=2)**

I want to introduce you to this extraordinary man and tell you why I’m so excited to join forces with him in this movement.****
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vp_rollout&n=3)
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vp_rollout&n=4 "WELCOME BUTCH!") [WELCOME BUTCH!](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vp_rollout&n=4)
---
Butch is an activist first. But he is also a dedicated educator, and – crucially in this moment – an honored historian whose work specializes in empire, colonialism, genocide and revolution.

For all of these reasons, **Butch Ware is exactly the person we need in a Vice President right now**.

Professor Ware is a leading academic authority on the U.S. Black Radical Tradition, Africa and Islam. He has served as a full faculty member at multiple prestigious universities, currently with UC Santa-Barbara, teaching in History, Black Studies, and Islamic Studies.

His critically acclaimed 2014 book, _The Walking Qurʼan: Islamic Education, Embodied Knowledge, and History in West Africa_ , was hailed by historians and academics as a landmark study and a significant contribution to both Islamic and African studies.

Throughout his career, Butch has repeatedly put his scholarship into service for change movements here at home and abroad – notably in the wake of George Floyd’s murder in 2020, and again in response to the ongoing genocide in Gaza. He has organized teach-ins, developed community education materials, and equipped activists with the knowledge they need to effect change.

Most importantly, as a Black Muslim man in America, Butch has the personal lived experience confronting systemic injustice that brings a critical perspective as we confront ongoing genocides, unprecedented levels of wealth inequality, and an accelerating climate emergency with the global south on the front lines.

It was that perspective that led to this exchange in a recent conversation between myself and Butch – and the moment I knew he would be an extraordinary running mate.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vp_rollout&n=5)
---
_“_** _Whether you vote red or whether you vote blue, militarized fascism wins._**_Right? That you’re essentially looking at a rivalry between two different factions of the 1% who have overlapping patronage networks.”

_ That statement strikes at the heart of every problem we seek to solve – that we do NOT have two major political parties in this country, but a single corporate-controlled uniparty with red and blue window dressing.

Neither Republicans nor Democrats stand for people, planet, or peace.

This campaign stands for a radically different vision for our country and our planet – one **rooted in justice and human thriving**. Professor Ware’s entire career as a scholar and an activist embodies this vision, and we need him in the White House with me.

Ours is the only campaign with a path to the White House that will **end the genocide in Gaza** and pursue an immediate arms embargo and permanent ceasefire with **justice for Palestine**. The only campaign **confronting the climate emergency** with the urgency it demands. And the only campaign with a **radically transformative economic vision** to build a society free of injustice, inequity, hunger, and want.

**[We have less than 90 days to deliver our mandate for people, planet, and peace at the ballot box – and we have a LOT of ground to cover. Will you join forces with Butch and me with a contribution of $25, $50, $100 or more today?](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vp_rollout&n=6)**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vp_rollout&n=7 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vp_rollout&n=7)
---
This is truly a historic ticket bringing together a Jewish woman and Black Muslim man against genocide, endless war, climate collapse, and rampant injustice.

Together, we can build an economy that works for working people, a livable future for our children, and an America and a world that works for all of us.

**I am thrilled, humbled, and honored to work for this vision alongside Butch and all of you.

** In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vp_rollout&n=8 "Support Jill Today!") | | Dear Friend, My heart is breaking for Officer Daniel Sanchez, and I need your help to keep him out of prison and with his wife and family where he belongs. You see, Daniel is facing a decade behind bars because he followed his training and defended himself and others against a deadly threat. Because of the political motivations of one anti-cop prosecutor, Daniel’s life could be ruined... ...and to top it all off, Daniel’s wife is now pregnant with their first child. This little family that is just starting could be ripped apart unjustly! **[**Please consider sending an urgent gift of $35 to help us defend Daniel against the baseless charges against him that could land him in prison for TEN YEARS.**](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8jsFuqzAQRb9m2BmZwcbxwov3GrGI1GW6rWzPuFiFgMBpyt9XRFW3V0f3HD8tY067A_MfEIdMGyBC-w8Q76V989fr67qLS3cRjxb5mAFfALHsC_-Rvyc1Tz6Px2rOFTmFvkmxYtcYbC0aq0w1OE06ykQdcVDKk9XJamMxpiZ1MoRYZYcSlTw1BqVG1LVKOumTR2tsoNRaUPIpqtPKXIZ8--SVfB73Os5TNbqhlGV7hvWA_cbxvnLtb0xzOQjA_hYXAuwpiIIkeBKdEvxdoO23-b5Gfo8zMbRnCuJABU-dCkI2slodLY88jnnrDCj58ew4tF8OfwIAAP__qspkMg)** In 2020, Jose Garza campaigned for District Attorney of Travis County, Texas, with a goal. Not to prosecute criminals, not to protect the community he was elected to serve...but to go after cops who risk their lives every day to help citizens like you and me stay safe. When Garza got elected, he made good on his promise and began prosecuting police officers one after another, even digging up old cases to prove a political point. Officers like Daniel Sanchez are being caught in the crosshairs of a battle they didn’t agree to and don’t deserve. Now Daniel is facing the possibility of ten years in prison.
---
[](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8jsFuqzAQRb9m2BmZwcbxwov3GrGI1GW6rWzPuFiFgMBpyt9XRFW3V0f3HD8tY067A_MfEIdMGyBC-w8Q76V989fr67qLS3cRjxb5mAFfALHsC_-Rvyc1Tz6Px2rOFTmFvkmxYtcYbC0aq0w1OE06ykQdcVDKk9XJamMxpiZ1MoRYZYcSlTw1BqVG1LVKOumTR2tsoNRaUPIpqtPKXIZ8--SVfB73Os5TNbqhlGV7hvWA_cbxvnLtb0xzOQjA_hYXAuwpiIIkeBKdEvxdoO23-b5Gfo8zMbRnCuJABU-dCkI2slodLY88jnnrDCj58ew4tF8OfwIAAP__qspkMg)
---
Why? In November 2022, the officer responded to a house call where a man was firing shots into a house indiscriminately. Daniel shouted to the suspect, who had already fired two shots into the house, to drop his gun. When the suspect refused, Daniel had no other choice but to fire his weapon to stop the imminent danger to himself and to the innocent people in the densely populated neighborhood. Within a minute of being shot by Daniel, police officers performed life-saving measures on the suspect but were unsuccessful in saving him. Now, Daniel is the one being treated like a common criminal. **[I pray you’ll consider donating to Officer Daniel Sanchez’s defense with a gift of $35 or more today to help us hire the best lawyers possible to defend him.](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8jsFuqzAQRb9m2BmZwcbxwov3GrGI1GW6rWzPuFiFgMBpyt9XRFW3V0f3HD8tY067A_MfEIdMGyBC-w8Q76V989fr67qLS3cRjxb5mAFfALHsC_-Rvyc1Tz6Px2rOFTmFvkmxYtcYbC0aq0w1OE06ykQdcVDKk9XJamMxpiZ1MoRYZYcSlTw1BqVG1LVKOumTR2tsoNRaUPIpqtPKXIZ8--SVfB73Os5TNbqhlGV7hvWA_cbxvnLtb0xzOQjA_hYXAuwpiIIkeBKdEvxdoO23-b5Gfo8zMbRnCuJABU-dCkI2slodLY88jnnrDCj58ew4tF8OfwIAAP__qspkMg)** The thing is, NCPD doesn’t receive a dime from the federal government – 100% of our funding comes from private donations. While Jose Garza has power and government funding on his side, we’re starting from scratch to fund the defense of public servants who don’t have hundreds in thousands of dollars in savings for legal battles like this. This truly is a David and Goliath situation – and not only is one man’s future on the line, but the future of his wife and unborn child are in jeopardy. It’s going to take the best lawyers available to defend him against, and that comes at a hefty cost. **[Please don’t delay in giving $35, $50, $100, or whatever you can spare to provide Daniel with the expert defense he needs and deserves.](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8jsFuqzAQRb9m2BmZwcbxwov3GrGI1GW6rWzPuFiFgMBpyt9XRFW3V0f3HD8tY067A_MfEIdMGyBC-w8Q76V989fr67qLS3cRjxb5mAFfALHsC_-Rvyc1Tz6Px2rOFTmFvkmxYtcYbC0aq0w1OE06ykQdcVDKk9XJamMxpiZ1MoRYZYcSlTw1BqVG1LVKOumTR2tsoNRaUPIpqtPKXIZ8--SVfB73Os5TNbqhlGV7hvWA_cbxvnLtb0xzOQjA_hYXAuwpiIIkeBKdEvxdoO23-b5Gfo8zMbRnCuJABU-dCkI2slodLY88jnnrDCj58ew4tF8OfwIAAP__qspkMg)** I’ll make sure Daniel and his wife know that you donated, and I know they’ll be so happy to hear they have your support during this difficult time. Gratefully, Jim Fotis

When the suspect refused, Daniel had no other choice but to fire his weapon to stop the imminent danger to himself and to the innocent people in the densely populated neighborhood. Within a minute of being shot by Daniel, police officers performed life-saving measures on the suspect but were unsuccessful in saving him. Now, Daniel is the one being treated like a common criminal. The thing is, NCPD doesn’t receive a dime from the federal government – 100% of our funding comes from private donations. While Jose Garza has power and government funding on his side, we’re starting from scratch to fund the defense of public servants who don’t have hundreds in thousands of dollars in savings for legal battles like this. This truly is a David and Goliath situation – and not only is one man’s future on the line, but the future of his wife and unborn child are in jeopardy. It’s going to take the best lawyers available to defend him against, and that comes at a hefty cost. I’ll make sure Daniel and his wife know that you donated, and I know they’ll be so happy to hear they have your support during this difficult time. Attorney General of California before serving in the U.S. Senate —
prosecuting this one.

justice by putting away sex offenders. Business fraudsters. Career
criminals. Guys like Donald Trump.

taking action — by the millions.

Steve Garvey, but outpace the more than $6 million in Republican money

we can not only win this election — we can deliver Kamala Harris and Tim
Walz the Democratic majorities they will need to get things done.

name: LCV Membership Team
subject: Two years of the Affordable Clean Energy Plan: take a look at the progress we’ve made
body:
Energy efficient homes. Green job creation. Environmental justice. And that’s not all...

If you are unable to see the message below, [click here to view](https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTEzNzIwNDcS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjA0MDI3ODMxOQS2&mt=1&rt=0).
| | | |
---
|
* * *
---
| | | | Hi Peter — Just over two years ago, we celebrated the passage of the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA), or what we call the affordable clean energy plan: **the world’s largest-ever investment in climate and clean energy to date!** Passing a momentous bill like the clean energy plan took years of work from all of us, and translating it into real-world benefits takes all of us, as well.
---
| | With the support of dedicated LCV members like you, and strong leadership from the Biden-Harris administration, we have spent these last two years holding elected leaders accountable to implement and steward the promises set forth by the IRA — including by defending these investments against repeated attacks from polluters and their allies in Congress.
---
| | Our efforts have helped to roll out countless initiatives that are **making it easier for everyday people to save hundreds of dollars on energy costs, creating hundreds of thousands of clean energy jobs, and investing in environmental justice in historically polluted and disadvantaged communities to create a cleaner and more equitable future for all.**
---
| | | [ Learn More ](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/G8bxcKm4Y4C-)
---
| | Take a look at just a _fraction_ of what’s been accomplished since the IRA was passed:
---
| | 🏡 [**Energy efficient home upgrades.**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/-)** ** The IRA has helped to save everyday people up to 30% on upfront costs of installing more energy efficient appliances such as induction stoves, insulation, heat pumps, and rooftop solar through tax credits.
---
| | **💪**[**Creating green jobs in nearly every state.**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/RZbkcR67_)** ** Since 2022, the IRA has helped to create more than 330,000 good-paying, clean energy jobs throughout the country, many of which do not require a four-year college degree.
---
| | **🌳**[** _Investing in environmental justice._**](https://links.messages.lcv.) Programs like the [**EPA’s Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/j9y2f0EGmGCV/YlhhdTY2SjE4NUIrMmhpdHh6Z2ZQQW5mWHZaeFVTekFidVFNUXRGZ0l0VGxCZFB4T0tXMlpHQjFOSUJtSHZ5UDN0SENIQVJvRlV2dnM5T0JwYXNGSTBmeXJlSks3anJRSmNXdll2amdJeGs9S0/) drive both public and private investment in climate and clean energy projects, already reaching nearly half a trillion dollars in just two years, and helping communities to make these projects a _reality_. The program will fund tens of thousands of projects, especially in low-income and disadvantaged communities, such as energy efficient retrofits for homes that will result in cleaner air, lower energy bills, and more good jobs nationwide.
---
| | And that’s just scratching the surface, Peter. Your support has already made an incredible impact on our environment over the last two years — **we’re excited to keep scoring** _**huge wins**_**for our communities and our climate with you alongside us.**[**Check out our blog for more information on major wins we’re celebrating since the passage of the IRA.**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/~)
---
| | The future is in your hands. Include LCV in your will or estate plans and help create a safe and equitable future for all.
---

clean_body: Energy efficient homes. Green job creation. Environmental justice. And that’s not all... If you are unable to see the message below, . | | | | | | | | | Hi Peter — Just over two years ago, we celebrated the passage of the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA), or what we call the affordable clean energy plan: the world’s largest-ever investment in climate and clean energy to date! Passing a momentous bill like the clean energy plan took years of work from all of us, and translating it into real-world benefits takes all of us, as well. | | With the support of dedicated LCV members like you, and strong leadership from the Biden-Harris administration, we have spent these last two years holding elected leaders accountable to implement and steward the promises set forth by the IRA — including by defending these investments against repeated attacks from polluters and their allies in Congress. | | Our efforts have helped to roll out countless initiatives that are making it easier for everyday people to save hundreds of dollars on energy costs, creating hundreds of thousands of clean energy jobs, and investing in environmental justice in historically polluted and disadvantaged communities to create a cleaner and more equitable future for all. | | | | | Take a look at just a fraction of what’s been accomplished since the IRA was passed: | | 🏡 The IRA has helped to save everyday people up to 30% on upfront costs of installing more energy efficient appliances such as induction stoves, insulation, heat pumps, and rooftop solar through tax credits. | | 💪 Since 2022, the IRA has helped to create more than 330,000 good-paying, clean energy jobs throughout the country, many of which do not require a four-year college degree. | | 🌳 Programs like the drive both public and private investment in climate and clean energy projects, already reaching nearly half a trillion dollars in just two years, and helping communities to make these projects a reality. The program will fund tens of thousands of projects, especially in low-income and disadvantaged communities, such as energy efficient retrofits for homes that will result in cleaner air, lower energy bills, and more good jobs nationwide. | | And that’s just scratching the surface, Peter. **$7.** That’s all we’re asking from you to help elect Democrats in the states. Here’s why: **Reason #1:** Election Day is only 80 days away, and in November, we’re facing legislative elections in 44 states – $7 helps win races like those and more. **Reason #2:** We’re up against Trump and his MAGA movement who raised over $300 million last quarter. When enough grassroots Democrats chip in $7, it adds up and helps our candidates compete. **Reason #3:** Losing in November means Republicans will gain an advantage in key battleground states for years to come – $7 helps defeat extremists who are determined to attack abortion rights and access to the ballot. [So what do you say? ---
We're writing to ask you to make a donation to the DNC today. Not tomorrow, not next week. But **today**. Here's why: We are just weeks away from the first votes being cast in this election in states like Virginia and Minnesota -- states we need to win to defeat Trump and hold the Senate. There are persuadable voters we need to reach before that happens. After they vote, it's too late. That's why we need the resources to reach them now. But there's more than that. There will be A LOT of coverage of early vote numbers. And the higher the vote totals, the more Democrats in other states will be motivated to vote early -- racking up more votes for us ahead of Election Day. That's why we're asking for your help today. You might have noticed my pin, but here's what it's all about:
| | |
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91029482/492478157/-1893289703?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&recurring=1&refcode=jtk2531-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiN2ZkYmM1Ni1mMTVjLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7z2p2PkOwTcd-JbrH-KEp2d573FyINwM700bUBpgBzA=)
Friend, you might have noticed, but where most of my colleagues wear the official Senate pin, I wear a pin depicting a canary in a birdcage. It's a reminder of how far we've come fighting for the Dignity of Work and how far we still have to go.
This pin was given to me two decades ago by a Lorain steelworker at a Workers' Memorial Day rally. I proudly wear it every day on the lapel of my suits – because it represents all of us.
In the early days of the 20th century, coal miners had to take a canary down into the mines to warn them of poisonous gas. Those workers didn't have a union strong enough or a government that cared enough to protect them.

Over the last 100 years, we changed that. We passed worker safety laws and overtime pay. We banned child labor. We passed clean air and safe drinking water laws. We enacted Social Security and Medicare and recognized workers' rights, women's rights, and civil rights.

But progress didn't happen on its own. **It happened because people like you and me stood up and demanded their government work for them.** It was citizens and workers, in union halls and church basements. It was civil rights activists and child advocates who took on powerful special interests and changed this country for the better.

**But when we see my MAGA opponent's campaign being funded by special interests and GOP super PACs, and a Trump-Vance ticket running to roll back the progress we've made, we know that our fight is far from over.

It's going to take every single one of us stepping up to do our part, so I have to ask: [Will you chip in $5 or more to help us win this race and keep up the fight for the Dignity of Work?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91029483/492478158/-1893289703?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk2531-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiN2ZkYmM1Ni1mMTVjLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7z2p2PkOwTcd-JbrH-KEp2d573FyINwM700bUBpgBzA=)**
